sop_examples.condition: The fan motor temperature sensor triggers the high-temperature alarm threshold while the fan continues to rotate at normal speed.

sop_examples.title: Fan Motor Complete Stoppage with Overload Trip
sop_examples.condition: The fan tachometer reads zero RPM and the motor overload relay has tripped, indicating the fan has ceased all rotation due to a fault.

sop_examples.title: Fan Running Below Minimum Required Speed
sop_examples.condition: The fan tachometer reads a sustained value below 80 percent of design RPM while the motor remains energized and the shaft is still turning.

sop_examples.title: Makeup Water Supply Zero Flow Fault
sop_examples.condition: The makeup water flow meter reads zero while the basin level sensor concurrently indicates the water level is dropping below setpoint.

sop_examples.title: Basin Water Conductivity Exceeds Upper Treatment Limit
sop_examples.condition: The online conductivity probe reads above 1500 microsiemens per centimeter, indicating dissolved solids are concentrated beyond the treatment program ceiling.

sop_examples.title: Basin Water Conductivity Below Minimum Treatment Threshold
sop_examples.condition: The online conductivity probe reads below 500 microsiemens per centimeter, indicating excessive dilution that wastes chemical treatment program dosage.

sop_examples.title: Blowdown Valve Fail-to-Operate Fault
sop_examples.condition: The blowdown valve position sensor shows a discrepancy between the commanded position and the actual position persisting beyond 30 seconds.

sop_examples.title: Drift Eliminator Differential Pressure High Alarm
sop_examples.condition: Differential pressure across the drift eliminator section exceeds 0.8 inches water column, indicating biological fouling or structural damage to the media.

sop_examples.title: Fan Assembly Vibration Warning Level Alarm
sop_examples.condition: The fan shaft vibration sensor reads above the 0.3 in/sec warning threshold but remains below the 0.6 in/sec emergency trip setpoint, and the fan continues to run.

sop_examples.title: Fan Assembly Vibration Emergency Shutdown
sop_examples.condition: The fan shaft vibration sensor has exceeded the 0.6 in/sec emergency trip setpoint, causing the control system to automatically de-energize the fan motor.

sop_examples.title: Scheduled Quarterly Fill Media Inspection
sop_examples.condition: The quarterly preventive maintenance calendar interval for fill media structural and fouling assessment has been reached.

sop_examples.title: Fan Drive Belt Scheduled Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The fan drive belt has reached its 2000-hour service interval or visible cracking and glazing are confirmed on the belt surface during inspection.

sop_examples.title: Scheduled Basin Sediment Cleanout
sop_examples.condition: Quarterly basin cleaning interval has elapsed or sediment accumulation is visually confirmed at more than 2 inches depth during a basin walkdown.

sop_examples.title: Scheduled Weekly Biocide Chemical Treatment
sop_examples.condition: The weekly water treatment program schedule requires addition of an oxidizing biocide to basin water to control Legionella and biological fouling.

sop_examples.title: Fan Shaft Bearing Scheduled Lubrication
sop_examples.condition: The monthly OEM-specified lubrication interval for fan shaft pillow block bearings has been reached per the preventive maintenance calendar.

sop_examples.title: Routine Weekly Water Quality Sample Collection
sop_examples.condition: The weekly water quality monitoring schedule requires collection of basin water for laboratory analysis of treatment chemistry balance and microbiological content.

sop_examples.title: Cooling Tower Lockout-Tagout Energy Isolation
sop_examples.condition: Maintenance work requiring entry into the tower structure or physical contact with energized components mandates full lockout-tagout isolation prior to access.

sop_examples.title: Water Treatment Chemical Spill Containment Response
sop_examples.condition: A water treatment chemical has been released onto the floor at the basin area or dosing station and requires immediate pump shutdown, containment, and decontamination.

sop_examples.title: Cooling Tower Planned Startup Sequence
sop_examples.condition: The cooling tower is ready to be returned to service following a planned maintenance outage, seasonal recommissioning, or extended production shutdown.

sop_examples.title: Cooling Tower Planned Shutdown Sequence
sop_examples.condition: A controlled shutdown of the cooling tower is required for scheduled maintenance, seasonal decommissioning, or extended planned production downtime.

sop_examples.title: Shot Pressure Below Injection Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: Shot pressure sensor reads below 850 bar at the start of the injection phase, before the plunger has completed 10% of its stroke.

sop_examples.title: Shot Pressure Exceeding Upper Ceiling
sop_examples.condition: Shot pressure sensor reads above 1200 bar during the injection stroke, triggering the high-pressure alarm.

sop_examples.title: Shot Pressure Sudden Mid-Stroke Collapse
sop_examples.condition: Shot pressure sensor registers a drop of more than 200 bar within one second during an active plunger stroke that had already reached nominal pressure.

sop_examples.title: Die Temperature Below Preheat Minimum
sop_examples.condition: Die surface temperature sensor reads below 150 degrees C minimum preheat threshold before the next shot cycle is permitted to begin.

sop_examples.title: Die Temperature Exceeding Upper Limit
sop_examples.condition: Die surface temperature sensor reads above 320 degrees C upper limit during or immediately after a casting cycle.

sop_examples.title: Furnace Molten Aluminum Level Below Minimum
sop_examples.condition: Furnace level sensor reads below 40% fill mark, indicating insufficient molten aluminum to complete a full shot.

sop_examples.title: Minor Coolant Drip at Die Cooling Fitting
sop_examples.condition: Coolant flow sensor shows a 5 to 10 percent flow reduction and visual dripping is observed at a die cooling line fitting, with no spray or pooling.

sop_examples.title: Coolant Line Burst at Die Cooling Manifold
sop_examples.condition: Coolant pressure sensor drops suddenly by more than 30 percent and a spray or burst of coolant is detected at the die cooling manifold, presenting a steam explosion risk near molten metal.

sop_examples.title: Shot Sleeve Plunger Advance Jam
sop_examples.condition: Plunger position sensor shows the plunger has not advanced past 25 percent of stroke within 2 seconds of injection command.

sop_examples.title: Ejector Pins Fail to Retract After Ejection
sop_examples.condition: Ejector pin return sensor indicates pins have not reached the fully retracted home position within 3 seconds of the ejection stroke completing.

sop_examples.title: Hydraulic Supply Pressure Low Warning
sop_examples.condition: Hydraulic system supply pressure sensor reads below 180 bar minimum while machine is in standby or between cycles, triggering a non-shutdown warning alarm.

sop_examples.title: Furnace Heater Band Circuit Fault
sop_examples.condition: Furnace heater band overcurrent alarm activates on the electrical panel, indicating a heater circuit fault that may cause furnace temperature to drop.

sop_examples.title: Between-Shot Die Release Agent Application
sop_examples.condition: Die lubricant application timer signals that release agent must be sprayed onto the die cavity surfaces before the next shot cycle.

sop_examples.title: Hydraulic Oil Filter Replacement
sop_examples.condition: Hydraulic filter differential pressure indicator has reached the replacement threshold, or the scheduled maintenance interval has elapsed.

sop_examples.title: Shot Sleeve Bore Cleaning and Inspection
sop_examples.condition: Shot sleeve bore inspection interval has elapsed or visual aluminum oxide buildup or carbon contamination is detected inside the sleeve.

sop_examples.title: Furnace Dross and Flux Skimming
sop_examples.condition: Dross accumulation sensor or inspection timer indicates that oxide crust and flux must be removed from the furnace melt surface.

sop_examples.title: Die Clamping Force and Tonnage Calibration Check
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled die clamping force calibration interval has been reached, or a cast part shows parting-line flash suggesting tonnage has drifted from specification.

sop_examples.title: Lockout Tagout for Die Change or Mechanical Maintenance
sop_examples.condition: A die change or any mechanical maintenance requiring access to the die casting machine interior is scheduled, requiring full energy isolation before work begins.

sop_examples.title: Molten Aluminum Spill on Machine or Floor
sop_examples.condition: Molten aluminum is observed outside the shot sleeve or die cavity on the machine base, apron, or surrounding floor area.

sop_examples.title: Emergency Stop Activation and Recovery
sop_examples.condition: An emergency stop button has been pressed by an operator or triggered by a safety device, halting all machine motion and interrupting the production cycle.

sop_examples.title: Full Cold-Start Machine Startup Procedure
sop_examples.condition: Machine has been fully de-energized and a new production shift is beginning, requiring a complete cold-start warm-up sequence before casting.

sop_examples.title: Planned End-of-Shift Machine Shutdown
sop_examples.condition: End-of-shift signal is received and no further production orders remain, requiring an orderly shutdown of the die casting machine.

sop_examples.title: Low Differential Pressure Warning Response
sop_examples.condition: Differential pressure across the filter bank has declined gradually to below the 3 in-WC minimum setpoint over multiple minutes or hours, triggering the yellow warning lamp on the control panel.

sop_examples.title: Sudden Differential Pressure Collapse Response
sop_examples.condition: Differential pressure drops to near-zero within a single scan cycle (under 60 seconds), indicating catastrophic filter bag rupture or housing breach rather than gradual blinding recovery.

sop_examples.title: High Differential Pressure Alarm Response
sop_examples.condition: Differential pressure has risen above the 6 in-WC high alarm setpoint, suggesting progressive filter blinding that may respond to additional manual pulse cleaning before requiring system shutdown.

sop_examples.title: Critical Differential Pressure Shutdown Response
sop_examples.condition: Differential pressure has exceeded the 9 in-WC critical shutdown threshold, placing the fan motor at immediate risk of overload damage and requiring emergency de-energization of the system.

sop_examples.title: Fan Motor Over-Temperature Alarm Response
sop_examples.condition: The fan motor winding temperature sensor exceeds 155 degrees C, triggering the thermal protection alarm at the motor control center while the fan remains rotating.

sop_examples.title: Fan Motor Under-Speed Fault Response
sop_examples.condition: The fan tachometer reads below 90 percent of the 1800 RPM design speed for more than 30 consecutive seconds while the motor remains energized, indicating belt slip or drive degradation but not complete failure.

sop_examples.title: Fan Motor Complete Stop Fault Response
sop_examples.condition: The fan tachometer reads zero RPM and the motor current sensor reads zero amperes simultaneously, indicating total motor or drive failure rather than a partial speed reduction.

sop_examples.title: Pulse Cleaning Valve Fault Response
sop_examples.condition: The pulse controller diagnostic indicates one or more solenoid valves failed to actuate during the timed cleaning cycle, reducing cleaning effectiveness on the affected filter row.

sop_examples.title: Hopper High-Level Alarm Response
sop_examples.condition: The capacitance level sensor in the dust hopper reaches the high-level setpoint, indicating the hopper is full and requires immediate discharge intervention.

sop_examples.title: Filter Bag Scheduled Replacement
sop_examples.condition: Filter bags have reached the 12-month service interval, or differential pressure trend data shows irrecoverable blinding that pulse cleaning cannot correct.

sop_examples.title: Pulse Valve Diaphragm Replacement
sop_examples.condition: A pulse valve diaphragm has reached the 6-month PM replacement interval or physical inspection reveals cracking and hardening that reduces pulse amplitude on the affected cleaning row.

sop_examples.title: Fan Shaft Bearing Lubrication
sop_examples.condition: Quarterly lubrication interval is due, or the fan bearing temperature sensor reads above 80 degrees C indicating insufficient grease in the bearing housing.

sop_examples.title: Dust Hopper Manual Cleanout
sop_examples.condition: Weekly cleanout interval is due, or the hopper level sensor reading is stagnant despite the rotary valve running, indicating material bridging or plugging at the hopper outlet cone.

sop_examples.title: Rotary Airlock Valve Inspection and Service
sop_examples.condition: Monthly PM interval for the rotary airlock valve is due, or audible grinding or scraping noise is detected from the valve body during normal operation.

sop_examples.title: Inlet Duct Buildup Inspection
sop_examples.condition: Monthly visual inspection interval for inlet ductwork is due, or the inlet airflow velocity sensor reads below 80 percent of design flow without a corresponding fan or filter fault.

sop_examples.title: Differential Pressure Manometer Calibration
sop_examples.condition: Semi-annual calibration interval is due, or the installed manometer reading deviates more than 0.5 in-WC from a portable reference gauge connected at the same test ports.

sop_examples.title: Dust Collector Lockout Tagout Isolation
sop_examples.condition: Any maintenance activity requiring physical entry into the dust collector housing, filter bank, or fan section, necessitating full de-energization of electrical and pneumatic energy sources before access.

sop_examples.title: Hopper Fire or Smoldering Response
sop_examples.condition: The hopper spark detector or thermal camera detects a temperature above 200 degrees C inside the hopper, indicating active combustion or smoldering of accumulated combustible dust.

sop_examples.title: Collected Dust Spill Response
sop_examples.condition: Collected dust from the system discharge is observed on the floor outside the normal discharge area, creating an inhalation hazard and slip risk for personnel in the area.

sop_examples.title: Dust Collector Normal Startup
sop_examples.condition: Plant shift start or restart after planned shutdown, with all maintenance complete, access doors closed, and the system cleared for operation.

sop_examples.title: Dust Collector Planned Shutdown
sop_examples.condition: End of production shift or planned system shutdown, requiring an orderly de-energization sequence to prevent residual dust from settling in ductwork.

sop_examples.title: Filter Bag Leak and Bypass Inspection
sop_examples.condition: A visible dust plume is observed at the clean-air outlet stack, or the outlet opacity monitor reads above 10 percent, indicating filter media bypass rather than clean exhaust.

sop_examples.title: Bus Voltage Below Minimum Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: The bus voltage sensor reads a sustained value below the 460 V minimum operating setpoint for more than 30 consecutive seconds.

sop_examples.title: Sudden Bus Voltage Collapse
sop_examples.condition: Bus voltage drops from normal operating range to below 50 V within a single one-second scan cycle, indicating catastrophic and instantaneous loss of supply voltage.

sop_examples.title: Bus Voltage Exceeds Maximum Ceiling
sop_examples.condition: The bus voltage sensor reads above 510 V, exceeding the maximum permissible ceiling for connected equipment.

sop_examples.title: Phase Current at Warning Threshold
sop_examples.condition: Any phase current sensor reads between 80 percent and 99 percent of the main breaker rated ampacity, triggering a warning-level alarm without yet tripping the breaker.

sop_examples.title: Main Breaker Tripped on Overcurrent
sop_examples.condition: The main circuit breaker has already opened due to a sustained overcurrent condition, removing power from all downstream distribution loads.

sop_examples.title: Ground Fault Relay Activated
sop_examples.condition: The ground fault protection relay has detected leakage current to earth and the ground fault indicator lamp is illuminated on the panel face.

sop_examples.title: Three-Phase Current Imbalance Detected
sop_examples.condition: The difference between the highest and lowest phase current readings exceeds ten percent of the average three-phase current, triggering the imbalance alarm relay.

sop_examples.title: Panel Internal Temperature at Caution Level
sop_examples.condition: The panel internal temperature sensor reads between 45 degrees C and 59 degrees C, exceeding the caution setpoint but remaining below the emergency shutdown threshold.

sop_examples.title: Panel Internal Temperature at Emergency Threshold
sop_examples.condition: The panel internal temperature sensor reads 60 degrees C or above, reaching the emergency threshold that requires immediate shutdown to prevent equipment damage or fire.

sop_examples.title: Power Meter Error Code or Frozen Reading
sop_examples.condition: The panel-mounted power meter display shows an alphanumeric error code or the kWh and kW readings have not updated for more than five minutes, indicating a meter communication or hardware fault.

sop_examples.title: Scheduled Circuit Breaker Visual Inspection
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled preventive maintenance interval for visual inspection of all circuit breakers has been reached per the monthly maintenance calendar.

sop_examples.title: Busbar and Panel Interior Cleaning
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled quarterly cleaning of busbars and panel interior surfaces is due per the preventive maintenance plan.

sop_examples.title: Panel Power Meter Calibration Verification
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled annual calibration verification of the panel-mounted power meter is due per the instrument calibration plan.

sop_examples.title: Panel Ventilation Filter Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The panel enclosure ventilation filter has reached its scheduled replacement interval or the cooling differential pressure sensor indicates filter clogging.

sop_examples.title: Scheduled Thermal Imaging Scan of Panel Internals
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled semi-annual thermal imaging inspection of panel internals is due per the preventive maintenance plan.

sop_examples.title: Main Panel Lockout-Tagout Procedure
sop_examples.condition: Maintenance work requiring de-energization of the main electrical panel is scheduled to begin and all personnel clearances have been obtained.

sop_examples.title: Main Panel Emergency Shutdown
sop_examples.condition: An imminent safety hazard such as visible arcing, smoke, or structural damage at the panel face requires immediate emergency de-energization of the main panel.

sop_examples.title: Arc Flash Event Response at Main Panel
sop_examples.condition: An arc flash event has occurred at or near the main electrical panel as evidenced by a visible flash, loud bang, or blast pressure wave from the enclosure.

sop_examples.title: Main Panel Energization After Maintenance Outage
sop_examples.condition: All maintenance work on the main electrical panel is complete, LOTO devices have been removed by authorized personnel, and the panel is ready to be re-energized.

sop_examples.title: Main Panel Controlled Shutdown for Planned Maintenance
sop_examples.condition: A planned maintenance window has been scheduled and all downstream loads have been confirmed de-energized, permitting controlled shutdown of the main panel.

sop_examples.title: Routine Power Factor and Harmonic Distortion Inspection
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled monthly power quality inspection is due, requiring review of power factor and total harmonic distortion readings from the panel-mounted instruments.

sop_examples.title: Breaker Terminal Torque Verification
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled annual torque verification of all circuit breaker terminal connections is due per the preventive maintenance plan.

sop_examples.title: Supply Level Below Low Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: The fill level sensor reads below the low-level setpoint continuously for more than 30 seconds during an active fill cycle.

sop_examples.title: Sudden Fill Level Collapse
sop_examples.condition: The fill level sensor reading drops by more than 40 percent within 5 seconds during normal operation, indicating supply line separation or rupture upstream.

sop_examples.title: Fill Level Exceeds Upper Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: The fill level sensor reading rises above the upper ceiling setpoint, indicating a risk of overfill into the fill vessel.

sop_examples.title: Pump Outlet Pressure Below Minimum Threshold
sop_examples.condition: The pump outlet pressure sensor reads below the minimum operating threshold for more than 15 seconds, resulting in reduced but nonzero flow at the nozzles.

sop_examples.title: Pump Outlet Pressure Exceeds Maximum Ceiling
sop_examples.condition: The pump outlet pressure sensor exceeds the maximum ceiling setpoint, indicating a downstream blockage that has halted or severely restricted nozzle flow.

sop_examples.title: Single Nozzle Partial Flow Restriction
sop_examples.condition: One fill nozzle channel reports a flow rate below 50 percent of nominal while all adjacent channels are operating within normal range.

sop_examples.title: Single Nozzle Complete Blockage
sop_examples.condition: A fill nozzle channel reports zero flow for more than 10 seconds while the fill cycle is active and all other channels are flowing normally.

sop_examples.title: Fill Level Sensor Signal Fault
sop_examples.condition: The fill level sensor returns an error code or an out-of-range value that does not correlate with the physically observable tank contents.

sop_examples.title: Minor Nozzle Fitting Drip Within Containment
sop_examples.condition: A slow drip or weep is detected at a nozzle-to-manifold fitting; accumulated fluid is confined to the drip tray and has not reached the floor.

sop_examples.title: Fill Line Rupture With Floor Contamination
sop_examples.condition: A fill line ruptures and releases product as an active spray beyond containment boundaries, with product detected on the floor.

sop_examples.title: Pump Shaft Seal Slow Weep
sop_examples.condition: The pump shaft seal shows slow fluid accumulation on the pump housing that has developed over multiple hours without active spraying or splashing.

sop_examples.title: Inline Filter Differential Pressure Changeout
sop_examples.condition: The inline filter differential pressure gauge reaches the change-out threshold or the scheduled replacement interval has elapsed.

sop_examples.title: Scheduled Nozzle Cleaning and Purge
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled nozzle cleaning interval has been reached or visible residue or crust buildup is observed on external nozzle inspection.

sop_examples.title: Pump Bearing Scheduled Lubrication
sop_examples.condition: The pump bearing lubrication interval has been reached per the preventive maintenance schedule.

sop_examples.title: Fill Level Sensor Zero and Span Calibration
sop_examples.condition: The fill level sensor calibration is due per the maintenance schedule or immediately following sensor replacement.

sop_examples.title: Fill Volume Accuracy Verification and Adjustment
sop_examples.condition: Fill volume accuracy check indicates drift outside acceptance tolerance, or scheduled volumetric calibration interval has elapsed.

sop_examples.title: Lockout Tagout Before Maintenance Access
sop_examples.condition: Any maintenance, repair, or adjustment work requiring physical access inside the filling machine guarding must be preceded by full energy isolation.

sop_examples.title: Product Spill Outside Containment Floor Response
sop_examples.condition: Product spillage is found on the floor outside primary containment but the fill line and pump are intact and there is no active spray.

sop_examples.title: Emergency Stop Engagement and Recovery
sop_examples.condition: An imminent personnel safety hazard or uncontrolled equipment condition requires immediate machine halt by engaging the nearest emergency stop device.

sop_examples.title: Beginning of Shift Startup Sequence
sop_examples.condition: The liquid filling machine requires startup at the beginning of shift before production can commence.

sop_examples.title: End of Shift Shutdown Sequence
sop_examples.condition: The liquid filling machine requires an orderly shutdown at the end of shift after all production fill cycles are complete.

sop_examples.title: In-Process Fill Weight Quality Inspection
sop_examples.condition: Periodic quality sampling of filled containers is required during active production to verify fill weight accuracy.

sop_examples.title: Suction Pressure Below Minimum Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: The suction pressure sensor reads below the minimum operating setpoint in a sustained, gradual drift rather than a sudden event.

sop_examples.title: Sudden Suction Pressure Collapse
sop_examples.condition: The suction pressure sensor drops to near-zero within a single scan cycle, indicating a catastrophic sudden loss rather than a gradual drift below setpoint.

sop_examples.title: Suction Pressure Above Upper Ceiling Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: The suction pressure sensor reads above the maximum allowable ceiling setpoint, indicating over-draw or a downstream restriction forcing the fan to pull harder than rated.

sop_examples.title: Filter Differential Pressure Advisory Warning
sop_examples.condition: The differential pressure sensor across the filter cartridge reaches the yellow advisory threshold, indicating partial clogging that requires scheduled attention but does not mandate immediate shutdown.

sop_examples.title: Filter Differential Pressure Critical Emergency Stop
sop_examples.condition: The differential pressure sensor across the filter cartridge reaches the red critical threshold requiring immediate unit shutdown to prevent motor damage or filter ignition.

sop_examples.title: Fan Motor Overtemperature Alarm
sop_examples.condition: The fan motor temperature sensor exceeds the maximum rated operating temperature, triggering a thermal protection alarm on the unit.

sop_examples.title: Extraction Arm Partial Resistance Fault
sop_examples.condition: The extraction arm position sensor confirms the arm is still moving but with measurable lag, indicating a sluggish, resistant arm that has not yet fully seized.

sop_examples.title: Extraction Arm Complete Seizure
sop_examples.condition: The extraction arm position sensor shows zero movement across consecutive readings and the arm cannot be repositioned, indicating a complete mechanical seizure.

sop_examples.title: Variable Frequency Drive Fault Code
sop_examples.condition: The variable frequency drive displays an active fault code and the fan motor stops completely, indicating an electrical control failure rather than a mechanical or thermal event.

sop_examples.title: Ambient Fume Concentration Above Permissible Exposure Limit
sop_examples.condition: The ambient fume sensor at the welding workstation reads above the permissible exposure limit, indicating inadequate fume capture at the source.

sop_examples.title: Primary Filter Cartridge Scheduled Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The primary filter cartridge has reached its scheduled replacement interval as tracked by the maintenance management system work order.

sop_examples.title: Pre-Filter Mesh Screen Weekly Cleaning
sop_examples.condition: The pre-filter mesh screen requires routine weekly cleaning per the preventive maintenance schedule, with the screen intact and not due for replacement.

sop_examples.title: Fan Drive Belt Biweekly Inspection
sop_examples.condition: The fan drive belt requires visual condition and tension verification per the biweekly preventive maintenance schedule, with no replacement activity planned.

sop_examples.title: Fan Drive Belt Emergency Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The fan drive belt has visibly cracked through or snapped, causing the fan to stop rotating and requiring immediate physical replacement of the belt.

sop_examples.title: Extraction Arm Pivot Joint Scheduled Lubrication
sop_examples.condition: The extraction arm pivot joints have reached their scheduled lubrication interval and require grease application to maintain free, low-resistance movement.

sop_examples.title: Airflow Velocity Sensor Calibration Verification
sop_examples.condition: The airflow velocity sensor calibration certificate has expired or a quality audit has flagged the sensor for recalibration against a traceable reference standard.

sop_examples.title: Full Lockout Tagout Before Internal Access
sop_examples.condition: Any maintenance activity requiring access inside the unit enclosure or proximity to energized components must be preceded by a full lockout-tagout energy isolation procedure.

sop_examples.title: Collected Particulate or Condensate Spill Response
sop_examples.condition: Collected fume particulate or condensate has escaped the drain outlet or collection bin and spilled onto the floor, creating a contamination and slip hazard.

sop_examples.title: Fire or Smoke Detection Emergency Stop
sop_examples.condition: Fire or smoke is detected inside or immediately adjacent to the fume extractor unit, requiring immediate emergency stop and facility alarm activation.

sop_examples.title: Standard Unit Startup at Shift Start
sop_examples.condition: The fume extractor unit must be brought online and verified operational at the start of a production shift before welding operations begin.

sop_examples.title: Standard Unit Shutdown at Shift End
sop_examples.condition: The fume extractor unit must be safely ramped down and powered off at the conclusion of a production shift.

sop_examples.title: Daily Pre-Shift Unit Condition Inspection
sop_examples.condition: A daily sensor-verified and visual inspection of the fume extractor must be completed and signed off before the start of each production shift.

sop_examples.title: Temperature Below Setpoint Recovery
sop_examples.condition: Zone thermocouple reads more than 15°C below target setpoint for five or more consecutive minutes during an active processing cycle.
steps: Read zone1_temp_sensor to determine deviation magnitude
Press heating_enable_button at zone1_control_panel to boost heat output
Wait 300 seconds for zone temperature to recover
Read zone1_temp_sensor to verify return to setpoint

sop_examples.title: Furnace Temperature Sudden Collapse Response
sop_examples.condition: Any zone temperature drops more than 50°C within a single 60-second scan interval, indicating catastrophic heating element failure or a hard power interruption.
steps: Press red_estop_button at zone1_control_panel to halt all operations immediately
Notify shift_supervisor and maintenance_tech of sudden temperature collapse
Walk to atmosphere_control_panel and press atmosphere_shutoff_valve_button
Wait 60 seconds for equipment to stabilize
Read heating_element_current_sensor to check for open-circuit fault

sop_examples.title: Furnace Overtemperature Alarm Response
sop_examples.condition: Any zone temperature exceeds the programmed upper safety ceiling by more than 5°C, triggering the high-temperature limit alarm.
steps: Walk to zone1_control_panel and press heating_disable_button immediately
Read zone1_temp_sensor and zone2_temp_sensor to confirm overtemperature reading
Press conveyor_stop_button at zone1_control_panel to halt part movement
Wait 120 seconds and re-read zone1_temp_sensor to track temperature descent
Notify quality_inspector to quarantine all parts processed during the overtemperature event

sop_examples.title: Protective Atmosphere Low Flow Warning Response
sop_examples.condition: Atmosphere gas flow rate drops below the minimum warning threshold but remains above the emergency shutoff level, triggering a yellow advisory alarm.
steps: Walk to atmosphere_control_panel and read atm_flow_sensor
Read atm_pressure_sensor to check upstream supply pressure
Walk to filter_housing and visually assess for restriction
Notify maintenance_tech of low-flow warning condition
Wait 120 seconds and re-read atm_flow_sensor to confirm trend
Notify shift_supervisor with updated atm_flow_sensor reading

sop_examples.title: Total Protective Atmosphere Loss Emergency
sop_examples.condition: Atmosphere gas flow drops to zero or below the emergency threshold, causing immediate oxidation risk to parts in process and requiring emergency shutdown.
steps: Press conveyor_stop_button at zone1_control_panel to freeze part positions
Walk to gas_shutoff_station and press atmosphere_shutoff_valve_button
Notify shift_supervisor and safety_officer of total atmosphere loss emergency
Wait 30 seconds then read co_gas_sensor to assess residual combustible atmosphere
Notify maintenance_tech with co_gas_sensor reading and current status

sop_examples.title: Quench Tank Oil Level Low Response
sop_examples.condition: Quench oil level sensor reads below the minimum operating level, indicating normal consumption or an undetected leak requiring immediate replenishment.
steps: Walk to quench_tank and read quench_level_sensor
Notify shift_supervisor of low quench oil level
Walk to oil_storage_area and pick quench_oil_drum
Walk to quench_tank and place quench_oil_drum at fill_port
Wait 60 seconds then read quench_level_sensor to verify level restored
Press quench_pump_start_button at quench_control_panel to resume quench circulation

sop_examples.title: Quench Oil Overtemperature Response
sop_examples.condition: Quench oil temperature sensor exceeds the maximum allowable quench temperature, reducing quench severity and posing flash-point risk.
steps: Walk to quench_control_panel and read quench_temp_sensor
Notify shift_supervisor of quench oil overtemperature condition
Press cooling_fan_start_button at quench_control_panel to accelerate cooling
Notify shift_supervisor with updated quench_temp_sensor reading
Press quench_pump_start_button once temperature returns to operating range

sop_examples.title: Heating Element Electrical Fault Response
sop_examples.condition: Heating element current sensor detects an open-circuit or short-circuit condition on one or more element banks during an active heat cycle.
steps: Walk to zone1_control_panel and read heating_element_current_sensor
Notify maintenance_tech and shift_supervisor of heating element fault
Press conveyor_stop_button to hold parts in current zone positions
Wait 300 seconds for element assemblies to cool
Notify maintenance_tech with heating_element_current_sensor readings for repair dispatch

sop_examples.title: Protective Atmosphere Filter Replacement
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled maintenance interval is reached or a low-flow warning is confirmed as caused by a filter restriction rather than a supply pressure issue.
steps: Walk to loto_panel and press loto_panel_button to initiate lockout sequence
Walk to filter_housing and pick replacement_atmosphere_filter
Walk to atmosphere_control_panel and press atmosphere_enable_button
Wait 60 seconds and read atm_flow_sensor to confirm restored flow
Notify maintenance_tech of completed filter change and current atm_flow_sensor reading

sop_examples.title: Full Quench Oil Drain and Replacement
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled quench oil change interval is reached or oil analysis results indicate fluid breakdown requiring full drain and replacement.
steps: Walk to loto_panel and press loto_panel_button to initiate lockout
Walk to quench_tank and pick oil_drain_plug
Place drain_pan at quench_tank drain outlet
Wait 600 seconds for full oil drain
Read quench_level_sensor to confirm proper fill level

sop_examples.title: Furnace Door Seal Inspection and Replacement
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled maintenance interval is reached or a visible atmosphere leak is detected at the furnace door perimeter during a routine inspection walk.
steps: Walk to loto_panel and press loto_panel_button to initiate lockout
Walk to door_seal_station and read door_seal_sensor
Walk to atmosphere_control_panel and read atm_pressure_sensor to verify seal integrity
Notify maintenance_tech of seal replacement completion and atm_pressure_sensor reading

sop_examples.title: Zone Thermocouple Calibration Procedure
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled calibration interval is reached or thermocouple accuracy drift is detected during a quality verification check.
steps: Walk to loto_panel and press loto_panel_button to initiate lockout
Walk to thermocouple_junction_box and pick thermocouple_calibrator
Place thermocouple_calibrator at zone1_control_panel connection point
Read zone1_temp_sensor and compare to thermocouple_calibrator reference
Walk to zone2_control_panel and read zone2_temp_sensor against thermocouple_calibrator
Notify maintenance_tech of calibration readings and any out-of-tolerance values

sop_examples.title: Heating Element Visual Inspection
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled preventive maintenance inspection is due or a prior heating element fault event requires follow-up physical examination of element condition.
steps: Walk to loto_panel and press loto_panel_button to initiate lockout
Wait 600 seconds for heating elements to cool to safe inspection temperature
Walk to zone1_control_panel and read heating_element_current_sensor for pre-inspection baseline
Walk to zone2_control_panel and read zone2_temp_sensor as reference
Notify maintenance_tech of inspection access readiness and sensor baseline readings
Press heating_enable_button at zone1_control_panel only after maintenance_tech clearance and lockout removal

sop_examples.title: Quench Tank Agitator Bearing Lubrication
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled lubrication interval for quench tank agitator bearings is reached per the preventive maintenance calendar.
steps: Walk to loto_panel and press loto_panel_button to initiate lockout
Walk to lubrication_station and pick grease_cartridge
Walk to quench_tank and place grease_cartridge at agitator_bearing_port
Wait 30 seconds for grease to distribute through bearing

sop_examples.title: Furnace Conveyor Chain Lubrication
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled lubrication interval for the furnace conveyor chain is reached or squealing noise is reported from the chain drive.
steps: Walk to loto_panel and press loto_panel_button to initiate lockout
Walk to lubrication_station and pick grease_cartridge
Walk to conveyor_access_panel and place grease_cartridge at chain_lubrication_port
Wait 20 seconds for grease to distribute across chain links
Press conveyor_start_button at zone1_control_panel after lockout removal

sop_examples.title: Furnace Full Lockout Tagout Procedure
sop_examples.condition: Any planned maintenance or repair activity requires complete isolation of all furnace energy sources before personnel access.
steps: Walk to zone1_control_panel and press stop_button
Walk to atmosphere_control_panel and press atmosphere_shutoff_valve_button
Walk to loto_panel and press loto_panel_button
Notify maintenance_tech that lockout is complete and all energy sources are at zero

sop_examples.title: Protective Atmosphere Gas Leak Emergency Response
sop_examples.condition: Co gas sensor reading rises above ambient background or physical detection of protective atmosphere gas leaking outside furnace containment boundaries.
steps: Walk to gas_shutoff_station and press atmosphere_shutoff_valve_button
Read co_gas_sensor to quantify leak concentration in the area
Notify safety_officer and shift_supervisor immediately with co_gas_sensor reading
Walk to fire_extinguisher_station and pick fire_extinguisher
Place fire_extinguisher at safe_standby_position near furnace perimeter
Notify maintenance_tech with co_gas_sensor reading for hazmat assessment

sop_examples.title: Furnace Area Fire Emergency Response
sop_examples.condition: Visible flames, fire alarm activation, or smoke is detected in or immediately around the furnace equipment.
steps: Notify safety_officer and shift_supervisor of fire emergency
Walk to fire_extinguisher_station and pick fire_extinguisher
Walk to atmosphere_control_panel and press atmosphere_shutoff_valve_button
Place fire_extinguisher at discharge_position adjacent to fire source

sop_examples.title: Quench Oil Spill Containment and Cleanup
sop_examples.condition: Quench oil is observed pooling on the floor around the quench tank or along the transfer path, indicating a fitting leak or overflow event.
steps: Notify shift_supervisor and safety_officer of spill location immediately
Walk to maintenance_cabinet and pick oil_absorbent_pads
Walk to quench_tank spill area and place oil_absorbent_pads over spill
Place oil_spill_kit at spill boundary to contain further spread
Read quench_level_sensor to assess volume of oil lost
Notify maintenance_tech with quench_level_sensor reading and estimated spill extent

sop_examples.title: Furnace Cold Start Procedure
sop_examples.condition: Furnace is in a fully de-energized cold state and a scheduled production startup is required.
steps: Walk to loto_panel and read loto_panel_button status to confirm all lockouts are cleared
Walk to atmosphere_control_panel and press atmosphere_enable_button
Wait 120 seconds and read atm_flow_sensor to confirm protective atmosphere is established
Walk to zone1_control_panel and press start_button
Press heating_enable_button at zone1_control_panel to begin heat ramp
Wait 1800 seconds for furnace zones to reach target setpoint
Read zone1_temp_sensor and notify shift_supervisor that furnace is production-ready

sop_examples.title: Furnace Planned Shutdown Procedure
sop_examples.condition: Planned end-of-shift or pre-maintenance shutdown is initiated with all parts cleared from the furnace chamber.
steps: Walk to zone1_control_panel and press heating_disable_button
Wait 300 seconds for initial thermal cooldown
Walk to atmosphere_control_panel and press atmosphere_shutoff_valve_button
Read zone1_temp_sensor to confirm temperature is falling safely
Notify shift_supervisor that planned shutdown is complete

sop_examples.title: Pre-Load and Post-Process Part Inspection
sop_examples.condition: A parts basket arrives at the load station or is discharged from the furnace, requiring dimensional and surface hardness verification before or after heat treatment.
steps: Walk to parts_load_area and pick parts_basket
Place inspection_gauge on sample parts in parts_basket to check dimensional conformance
Place surface_hardness_tester on sample part to verify hardness target
Notify quality_inspector with hardness and dimensional measurement readings

sop_examples.title: Low Supply Airflow — Gradual Decline
sop_examples.condition: Supply air volumetric flow sensor reads below 70% of setpoint for more than 5 consecutive minutes, with a gradual declining trend over the preceding hour.

sop_examples.title: Sudden Total Supply Airflow Loss
sop_examples.condition: Supply air volumetric flow sensor drops to below 5% of setpoint within a 30-second window with no preceding decline trend, indicating belt failure, fan seizure, or major mechanical obstruction.

sop_examples.title: Supply Air Temperature High Warning
sop_examples.condition: Supply air temperature sensor reads between 58°F and 64°F for more than 3 continuous minutes, placing it in the elevated warning band above the 55°F setpoint without breaching the critical alarm threshold.

sop_examples.title: Supply Air Temperature Critical Alarm — Above Ceiling
sop_examples.condition: Supply air temperature sensor reads above 64°F, breaching the hard emergency ceiling threshold and requiring immediate unit shutdown to prevent process heat exceedance.

sop_examples.title: Return Air Temperature Below Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: Return air temperature sensor reads below 65°F for more than 5 continuous minutes, indicating possible overcooling, zone bypass, or sensor drift requiring investigation.

sop_examples.title: Filter Differential Pressure High Alarm
sop_examples.condition: Filter differential pressure sensor reads above 1.0 in. WG, indicating excessive filter loading that is measurably restricting airflow through the unit.

sop_examples.title: Minor Cooling Coil Leak — Intermittent Drip
sop_examples.condition: Condensate pan moisture sensor detects intermittent dripping with no floor pooling and no condensate pan overflow sensor activation, suggesting a minor coil or fitting weep.

sop_examples.title: Major Coil Rupture — Floor Flooding
sop_examples.condition: Condensate pan overflow sensor AND floor moisture sensor both activate simultaneously, indicating substantial water release from coil rupture or chilled water line failure requiring emergency shutdown.

sop_examples.title: Fan Motor Over-Temperature Alarm
sop_examples.condition: Fan motor bearing temperature sensor reads above 185°F or motor winding temperature sensor exceeds the nameplate rated limit, triggering a thermal protection alarm.

sop_examples.title: Fan Running Below Target Speed
sop_examples.condition: Fan tachometer reads 15–40% below the commanded speed setpoint while the motor contactor is closed and the shaft is still rotating, indicating belt slip, sheave wear, or VFD output degradation.

sop_examples.title: Fan Completely Stopped While Motor Energized
sop_examples.condition: Fan tachometer reads zero RPM while the motor contactor is confirmed closed and current draw is present, indicating shaft seizure, coupling failure, or catastrophic mechanical jam.

sop_examples.title: Outside Air Damper Stuck Closed
sop_examples.condition: Outside air damper position sensor reads 0% open despite the actuator receiving a command signal greater than 20% open, completely blocking fresh air intake to the unit.

sop_examples.title: Return Air Damper Stuck Full Open
sop_examples.condition: Return air damper position sensor reads 100% open despite the actuator receiving a command to partially or fully close, causing uncontrolled recirculation and loss of fresh air balance.

sop_examples.title: Variable Frequency Drive Fault Alarm
sop_examples.condition: Variable frequency drive fault indicator illuminates and the drive trips itself offline with an error code displayed, stopping fan speed modulation and defaulting the motor to zero output.

sop_examples.title: Fan Motor Circuit Breaker Tripped
sop_examples.condition: Fan motor circuit breaker in the motor control center panel has tripped to the OFF position, fully de-energizing the fan motor without an accompanying VFD fault code.

sop_examples.title: Scheduled Filter Replacement
sop_examples.condition: Preventive maintenance schedule has reached the 90-day interval or filter differential pressure sensor reads above 0.8 in. WG, requiring filter media replacement.

sop_examples.title: V-Belt Tension Inspection and Adjustment
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled 30-day inspection requires verification of fan drive V-belt tension, alignment, and surface condition without removing or replacing the belt.

sop_examples.title: Fan Drive Belt Replacement
sop_examples.condition: V-belt inspection reveals cracking, fraying, glazing, or hardening, or belt tension cannot be restored to specification by adjustment alone, requiring full belt removal and replacement.

sop_examples.title: Cooling Coil Scheduled Cleaning
sop_examples.condition: Quarterly preventive maintenance schedule or coil section differential pressure above 0.3 in. WG requires fin-and-tube coil face cleaning to restore heat transfer efficiency.

sop_examples.title: Damper Linkage and Actuator Lubrication
sop_examples.condition: Semi-annual preventive maintenance schedule requires lubrication of all damper blade pivot points, linkage rod ends, and actuator drive shaft to prevent binding and wear.

sop_examples.title: HVAC Unit Lockout/Tagout
sop_examples.condition: Any maintenance task requiring physical access to rotating components, electrical panels, or pressurized refrigerant or water lines requires lockout/tagout of the AHU before work begins.

sop_examples.title: Emergency Stop and Immediate Shutdown
sop_examples.condition: Fire alarm activation, smoke detector trip within the AHU cabinet, operator personal safety emergency, or direct order from the safety officer requires immediate AHU shutdown.

sop_examples.title: System Pressure Below Setpoint Warning
sop_examples.condition: Hydraulic system pressure sensor reads below the 180 bar operating setpoint but remains above the 140 bar minimum trip threshold, triggering a low-pressure warning alarm.

sop_examples.title: Sudden Pressure Collapse Emergency
sop_examples.condition: Hydraulic system pressure drops from operating level to below 100 bar within five seconds, indicating a catastrophic loss event such as a ruptured line or seized valve.

sop_examples.title: System Pressure Exceeding Maximum Safe Ceiling
sop_examples.condition: Hydraulic system pressure sensor reads above 250 bar, the maximum rated ceiling, triggering a high-pressure critical alarm.

sop_examples.title: Accumulator Nitrogen Precharge Below Specification
sop_examples.condition: Static accumulator pressure gauge reads below 90 bar with the hydraulic system fully depressurized, indicating insufficient nitrogen precharge for energy storage capacity.

sop_examples.title: Pump Motor Current Overload Alarm
sop_examples.condition: Pump motor current sensor reads above 95 amps, exceeding the 90-amp rated load, triggering the motor overload protection relay.

sop_examples.title: Pump Running at Reduced Speed
sop_examples.condition: Pump speed sensor reads between 600 and 900 RPM, below the nominal 1450 RPM operating speed, while the pump motor remains energized and still rotating.

sop_examples.title: Pump Fully Stopped and Not Rotating
sop_examples.condition: Pump speed sensor reads zero RPM and the motor contactor indicates de-energized state while the system start command remains active.

sop_examples.title: Minor Hydraulic Fluid Seal Seep
sop_examples.condition: A small hydraulic fluid seep is detected at a manifold fitting or cylinder seal, producing a wet stain or slow drip with no floor pooling.

sop_examples.title: Major Hydraulic Line Rupture and Fluid Release
sop_examples.condition: A high-pressure hydraulic line has burst, releasing a large volume of fluid rapidly with visible spray or floor pooling across a significant area.

sop_examples.title: Hydraulic Fluid Temperature High Warning
sop_examples.condition: Fluid temperature sensor reads above 60 degrees Celsius, the warning threshold, while the cooler is running and the system remains operational.

sop_examples.title: Hydraulic Fluid Temperature Critical Shutdown
sop_examples.condition: Fluid temperature sensor reads above 80 degrees Celsius, the critical shutdown threshold, requiring immediate pump stop to prevent fluid degradation and seal damage.

sop_examples.title: Return Line Filter Element Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The differential pressure indicator on the return filter housing exceeds 6 bar, or the scheduled 500-hour filter replacement interval has been reached.

sop_examples.title: Pump Suction Strainer Inspection and Cleaning
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled 250-hour suction strainer maintenance interval has been reached, or audible cavitation is detected from the pump inlet.

sop_examples.title: Hydraulic Fluid Sample Collection for Analysis
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled 250-hour oil sampling interval has been reached, or a change in system performance suggests possible fluid contamination.

sop_examples.title: Hydraulic Reservoir Fluid Level Top-Off
sop_examples.condition: Fluid level sensor reads in the low zone between the low-level warning mark and the low-level trip mark, requiring fluid addition to restore operating level.

sop_examples.title: Accumulator Nitrogen Precharge Recharge
sop_examples.condition: Accumulator nitrogen precharge confirmed below 90 bar following pump shutdown, requiring recharge to restore energy storage specification of 100 bar.

sop_examples.title: Pump Motor Bearing Lubrication
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled 1000-hour lubrication interval for pump motor drive-end and non-drive-end bearings has been reached.

sop_examples.title: Hydraulic Power Unit Lockout-Tagout Procedure
sop_examples.condition: Any maintenance task requiring physical entry into the HPU enclosure or disconnection of hydraulic lines, requiring full energy isolation before work begins.

sop_examples.title: Hydraulic Oil Spill Containment and Cleanup
sop_examples.condition: Hydraulic fluid pooling is detected on the floor in the HPU area, presenting a slip hazard and environmental risk.

sop_examples.title: Emergency Stop Activation and Response
sop_examples.condition: An immediate safety hazard is detected in the HPU area requiring instantaneous shutdown of all hydraulic power.

sop_examples.title: Cold Start Hydraulic Power Unit Startup Procedure
sop_examples.condition: Hydraulic power unit has been fully shut down and cooled to ambient temperature, requiring a complete startup sequence to bring the system to operating condition.

sop_examples.title: Controlled Planned Shutdown Procedure
sop_examples.condition: A scheduled production stop or end-of-shift shutdown is required, necessitating an orderly reduction and safe de-energization of the hydraulic system.

sop_examples.title: Hydraulic Pressure Below Setpoint Warning
sop_examples.condition: The hydraulic pressure sensor reads between the low-pressure warning threshold and the critical alarm floor while the press is actively cycling.

sop_examples.title: Sudden Hydraulic Pressure Collapse During Cycle
sop_examples.condition: Hydraulic system pressure drops instantaneously to below ten percent of the operating setpoint while the ram is mid-stroke under forming load.

sop_examples.title: Hydraulic Pressure Exceeds Maximum Rated Ceiling
sop_examples.condition: The hydraulic pressure sensor reading exceeds the system maximum rated operating pressure alarm threshold, indicating runaway pressure build-up.

sop_examples.title: Ram Descent Velocity Below Specified Rate
sop_examples.condition: The ram is descending but at a speed measurably slower than the programmed cycle time tolerance, with no full stop occurring.

sop_examples.title: Ram Completely Stalled at Mid-Stroke Position
sop_examples.condition: The ram has ceased all movement at an intermediate position and will not advance or retract in response to any control input.

sop_examples.title: Hydraulic Oil Temperature Elevated Above Normal Range
sop_examples.condition: The oil temperature sensor reading exceeds the normal operating upper limit but remains below the automatic shutdown interlock threshold, and the press continues to run.

sop_examples.title: Hydraulic Oil Temperature Triggers Automatic Shutdown Interlock
sop_examples.condition: Oil temperature exceeds the automatic shutdown interlock setpoint, causing the press control system to disable the hydraulic pump and halt all press motion.

sop_examples.title: Minor Hydraulic Oil Seep at Fitting or Cylinder Seal
sop_examples.condition: A slow drip or surface seep of hydraulic oil is detected at a hose fitting, connection, or cylinder seal with no floor pooling observed.

sop_examples.title: High-Pressure Hydraulic Hose Rupture and Oil Spray
sop_examples.condition: A hydraulic hose or pressurized fitting fails catastrophically, producing high-velocity oil spray or rapid large-volume oil discharge that reaches the floor or surrounding equipment.

sop_examples.title: Pressure Relief Valve Rapid Cycling Under Load
sop_examples.condition: The hydraulic relief valve is audibly and measurably cycling open and closed in rapid succession while the press operates under normal forming load.

sop_examples.title: Hydraulic Pump Motor Thermal Overload Trip
sop_examples.condition: The hydraulic pump motor thermal overload relay has tripped, cutting power to the pump and halting all hydraulic flow.

sop_examples.title: Ram Position Sensor Signal Lost or Erratic
sop_examples.condition: The ram position encoder or proximity sensor generates an out-of-range, intermittent, or frozen signal that triggers a position fault alarm on the press controller.

sop_examples.title: Scheduled Hydraulic Oil Filter Element Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The hydraulic filter differential-pressure indicator reaches the scheduled change threshold or the planned preventive maintenance interval has elapsed.

sop_examples.title: Hydraulic Reservoir Oil Level Inspection and Top-Off
sop_examples.condition: The reservoir oil level sight glass reads below the minimum operating mark during a routine daily inspection, with no sign of oil degradation.

sop_examples.title: Complete Hydraulic Oil Drain Flush and Refill
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled full oil-change interval has been reached or oil analysis results indicate fluid degradation beyond acceptable contamination limits.

sop_examples.title: Hydraulic Pump Drive Coupling Grease Application
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled lubrication interval for the pump drive coupling has elapsed per the preventive maintenance calendar.

sop_examples.title: Hydraulic Oil Cooler Heat Exchanger Cleaning
sop_examples.condition: The temperature differential across the oil cooler exceeds the inspection threshold or the scheduled cleaning interval has elapsed, indicating fouled cooler fins.

sop_examples.title: Pressure Relief Valve Setpoint Testing and Adjustment
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled relief-valve calibration interval has elapsed or a maintenance work order has been raised following a pressure anomaly event requiring setpoint verification.

sop_examples.title: Hydraulic Press Lockout Tagout Energy Isolation
sop_examples.condition: A maintenance or repair task requires entry into the press hazard zone or physical contact with any hydraulic or electrical component.

sop_examples.title: Hydraulic Oil Spill Containment and Cleanup
sop_examples.condition: Hydraulic oil is observed pooling on the floor in any quantity sufficient to create a slip hazard or approach a floor drain.

sop_examples.title: Emergency Stop Activation and Press Safe-Down Procedure
sop_examples.condition: An e-stop button has been activated by any person due to an immediate safety hazard at or near the hydraulic press.

sop_examples.title: Daily Press Startup and End-of-Shift Shutdown Sequence
sop_examples.condition: The press is being placed into or removed from normal production service at the start or end of a scheduled shift.

sop_examples.title: Barrel Zone Temperature Below Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: Any barrel zone temperature controller reads more than 10 degrees C below its configured setpoint for longer than 5 continuous minutes during production.
steps: press_button heater_enable_button to confirm heater bands are energized
wait 300 seconds for zones to recover toward setpoint
notify process_engineer if any zone fails to recover within setpoint tolerance

sop_examples.title: Barrel Zone Temperature Sudden Spike Above Safety Ceiling
sop_examples.condition: Any barrel zone temperature exceeds the programmed safety ceiling by more than 15 degrees C as a rapid rise occurring within a single 30-second controller scan cycle.
steps: press_button red_estop_button to halt injection cycle immediately
notify process_engineer and maintenance_tech with all zone sensor readings
wait 600 seconds before any restart attempt pending engineer written clearance

sop_examples.title: Barrel Zone Temperature Gradual Drift Above Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: Any barrel zone temperature climbs more than 8 degrees C above its setpoint over a period exceeding 20 minutes without a rapid spike event and without a recipe change.
steps: press_button alarm_acknowledge_button to log the drift event timestamp
notify process_engineer with affected zone readings and elapsed drift duration
wait 120 seconds and read_sensor barrel_zone1_temp_sensor to confirm whether trend is continuing upward

sop_examples.title: Injection Pressure Below Fill Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: Injection cavity pressure falls more than 200 psi below the programmed fill setpoint during the injection phase of a shot cycle.
steps: press_button cycle_stop_button to pause production after current shot completes
notify process_engineer with both pressure readings and number of affected shots
wait 60 seconds for engineer assessment before resuming cycle

sop_examples.title: Injection Pressure Exceeding Safety Limit
sop_examples.condition: Injection pressure sensor reads above the programmed safety ceiling during any phase of the injection or pack portion of the shot cycle.
steps: notify maintenance_tech and process_engineer with both sensor readings
wait 300 seconds for system pressure to bleed down before any close approach
notify shift_supervisor that production is halted pending fault investigation

sop_examples.title: Hydraulic Clamp Pressure Slow Drop Warning
sop_examples.condition: Hydraulic clamp pressure decreases by more than 150 psi below the holding setpoint over a period of 10 or more minutes while the mold remains clamped between shots.
steps: press_button alarm_acknowledge_button to log the event
notify maintenance_tech with current pressure readings and measured drop duration
wait 300 seconds and read_sensor hydraulic_pressure_sensor again to assess whether drop is continuing

sop_examples.title: Sudden Hydraulic Clamp Pressure Collapse Emergency
sop_examples.condition: Hydraulic clamp pressure drops more than 500 psi within a single 10-second window while the mold is fully clamped and an active injection shot is in progress.
steps: notify maintenance_tech and shift_supervisor immediately with sensor reading
notify process_engineer that mold clamp integrity is suspect and await clearance before any approach

sop_examples.title: Material Jam in Hopper Throat
sop_examples.condition: Hopper throat bridging sensor triggers or screw recovery time exceeds the programmed threshold, indicating that pellets are bridging and not flowing from the hopper into the barrel.
steps: press_button cycle_stop_button to halt screw rotation after current shot completes
read_sensor hopper_level_sensor to confirm material is present but not flowing
place hopper_agitator_rod into hopper_throat to mechanically break the material bridge
notify process_engineer if material flow does not resume and recovery time normalizes

sop_examples.title: Barrel Heater Band Replacement
sop_examples.condition: A barrel zone temperature controller shows a persistent open-circuit fault code or the zone cannot heat to within 20 degrees C of setpoint after 15 minutes of energized soak time.
steps: notify maintenance_tech to confirm LOTO is applied before starting this procedure
read_sensor barrel_zone1_temp_sensor to identify which zone is faulted
read_sensor barrel_zone1_temp_sensor to verify replacement band is heating correctly

sop_examples.title: Hydraulic Oil Filter Cartridge Replacement
sop_examples.condition: Hydraulic filter differential pressure indicator reaches the red bypass zone, or the scheduled 500-hour filter replacement interval is reached per the preventive maintenance calendar.
steps: read_sensor hydraulic_filter_dp_sensor to confirm bypass indicator state
wait 120 seconds for system pressure to fully bleed down
press_button hydraulic_pump_start_button and read_sensor hydraulic_filter_dp_sensor to verify normal differential pressure

sop_examples.title: Injection Screw Thrust Bearing Lubrication
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled 250-hour lubrication interval for the injection screw thrust bearing is due per the preventive maintenance calendar.
steps: notify maintenance_tech that screw thrust bearing PM lubrication is starting
wait 60 seconds for drive unit to come to a complete stop
place grease_gun onto screw_thrust_bearing_zerk to inject specified grease quantity
read_sensor injection_pressure_sensor to confirm zero pressure before releasing machine

sop_examples.title: Mold Vent and Parting Line Cleaning
sop_examples.condition: Visual inspection reveals carbon or wax deposits on mold vents, or a short-shot trend in quality data indicates vents are partially blocked and degrading part fill at standard injection parameters.
steps: press_button cycle_stop_button after current shot completes
press_button mold_open_button to open clamp to full stroke
place mold_vent_brush onto mold_parting_line to scrub vent grooves and parting surface
press_button mold_close_button and notify process_engineer that vent cleaning is complete

sop_examples.title: Barrel and Nozzle Purge with Purging Compound
sop_examples.condition: A material or color changeover is required, or machine downtime has exceeded 30 minutes and degraded or contaminated material must be cleared from the barrel and nozzle before resuming production.
steps: press_button purge_button to initiate automatic purge cycle
wait 120 seconds for purge shots to complete
notify process_engineer to visually inspect purge shots for contamination clearance before resuming production

sop_examples.title: Barrel Zone Temperature Controller Calibration
sop_examples.condition: Quarterly calibration interval for barrel zone thermocouples and PID controllers is due per the calibration schedule, or any zone reads more than 5 degrees C from an independent reference measurement.
steps: notify maintenance_tech that barrel temperature calibration procedure is starting
read_sensor barrel_zone1_temp_sensor and compare displayed value against calibration_probe reference reading
press_button alarm_acknowledge_button to log each zone calibration result
notify process_engineer with offset values found for each zone requiring adjustment

sop_examples.title: Clamp Unit Tie Bar Lubrication
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled 500-hour lubrication interval for the clamp unit tie bars is due per the preventive maintenance calendar.
steps: press_button mold_open_button to open clamp to full stroke exposing tie bar surfaces
place tie_bar_grease_gun onto tie_bar_left_zerk to apply specified grease quantity
place tie_bar_grease_gun onto tie_bar_right_zerk to apply specified grease quantity
press_button mold_close_button to cycle clamp and distribute grease
notify maintenance_tech that lubrication is complete and log service hours

sop_examples.title: Lockout Tagout Procedure for Injection Molder Maintenance
sop_examples.condition: Any maintenance task requiring physical access to the mold area, barrel, screw, or hydraulic components must be preceded by full lockout tagout with machine power available on the line.
steps: press_button red_estop_button to initiate controlled stop
place loto_padlock onto loto_hasp to secure lockout and attach assigned tag

sop_examples.title: Minor Hydraulic Oil Spill Containment and Cleanup
sop_examples.condition: A hydraulic oil leak of less than one liter is observed pooling on the floor near the hydraulic power unit with no active spray or ongoing pressurized release.
steps: place oil_absorbent_pad onto spill_area adjacent to hydraulic_unit
wait 60 seconds for absorbent pad to soak up the pooled oil
notify shift_supervisor that spill has been contained and cleaned and log the event

sop_examples.title: Major Hydraulic Oil Rupture and Spill Emergency Response
sop_examples.condition: A hydraulic oil release greater than five liters is actively spraying or rapidly pooling on the floor from a ruptured hose or fitting, presenting immediate slip and fire ignition hazards.
steps: press_button hydraulic_pump_stop_button to cut hydraulic power and reduce flow
place spill_kit around spill_perimeter to contain lateral spread toward drains and walkways
notify shift_supervisor and maintenance_tech immediately for emergency response and area evacuation

sop_examples.title: Emergency Stop Activation and Safe Standby
sop_examples.condition: An unsafe condition, personnel hazard, unexpected machine motion, or critical fault requires immediate cessation of all machine motion and injection cycle activity.
steps: read_sensor injection_pressure_sensor to confirm pressure has reached zero
read_sensor hydraulic_pressure_sensor to confirm hydraulic pressure has reached zero
notify shift_supervisor with description of the unsafe condition that triggered the stop
wait 300 seconds before any personnel approach to machine
notify maintenance_tech to assess machine state and clear for restart

sop_examples.title: Cold Startup from Overnight or Extended Shutdown
sop_examples.condition: Machine has been fully shut down for eight or more hours and must be brought from ambient temperature to full production readiness including barrel soak.
steps: press_button heater_enable_button to begin barrel zone heating soak
wait 1800 seconds for all barrel zones to stabilize at setpoint
press_button hydraulic_pump_start_button and notify process_engineer that machine is at temperature and ready for first shot approval

sop_examples.title: End of Shift Planned Shutdown
sop_examples.condition: The production shift is ending and the machine must be safely shut down in a controlled sequence to prevent material degradation in the barrel and to leave equipment in a safe state for the next shift.
steps: press_button cycle_stop_button after the final production shot completes
press_button hopper_gate_close_button to stop material feed into barrel
press_button purge_button to purge remaining material from barrel and nozzle
wait 120 seconds for purge cycle to complete
press_button heater_disable_button and press_button hydraulic_pump_stop_button and notify shift_supervisor that shutdown is complete

sop_examples.title: Shot Weight and Part Weight Quality Inspection
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled every-two-hour quality check interval is due, or an SPC chart out-of-control signal requires verification that part weight is within the plus or minus 0.5 gram tolerance band.
steps: notify process_engineer if reading falls outside the tolerance band
place molded_part into approved_parts_bin or reject_bin based on the scale reading

sop_examples.title: Label Web Jam Clearance
sop_examples.condition: The label web has stopped feeding through the print-and-apply unit, triggering a web-jam alarm on the control panel.

sop_examples.title: Print Head Overtemperature Emergency
sop_examples.condition: The print head temperature sensor reads above the maximum rated threshold, triggering an overtemperature alarm and requiring immediate machine halt.

sop_examples.title: Print Head Below Operating Temperature
sop_examples.condition: The print head temperature is reading below the minimum operating setpoint with no active alarm, resulting in faint or incomplete thermal transfer on labels.

sop_examples.title: Applicator Pad Miss Alarm
sop_examples.condition: The applicator pad sensor has detected a consecutive series of label placement failures, tripping the miss-count alarm on the control panel.

sop_examples.title: Low Label Stock Warning
sop_examples.condition: The label stock sensor has reached the low-stock warning threshold; the machine continues running but a roll change is needed within the current shift.

sop_examples.title: Label Stock Exhausted — Line Halted
sop_examples.condition: The label stock is completely depleted and the labeler has halted production with an out-of-stock fault alarm active on the control panel.

sop_examples.title: Thermal Transfer Ribbon Break
sop_examples.condition: The thermal transfer ribbon has snapped during active production, causing completely blank labels and triggering a ribbon-break fault alarm.

sop_examples.title: Low Ribbon Stock Warning
sop_examples.condition: The ribbon stock sensor indicates the ribbon spool is approaching end-of-roll; print quality remains acceptable but a ribbon change is needed before the next scheduled break.

sop_examples.title: Pneumatic Air Pressure Low Warning
sop_examples.condition: The air pressure sensor reads below the minimum operating setpoint, triggering a low-pressure warning indicator; the applicator continues cycling but with noticeably reduced stroke force.

sop_examples.title: Sudden Pneumatic Pressure Loss — Applicator Stalled
sop_examples.condition: Air pressure has dropped instantaneously from normal operating level to near-zero, stalling the applicator arm mid-stroke and triggering an emergency pressure-loss fault.

sop_examples.title: Routine Print Head Cleaning
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled print head cleaning interval has been reached, or print quality has degraded due to ink residue or dust buildup on the print head surface.

sop_examples.title: Applicator Pad Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The applicator pad is worn, torn, or adhesive-contaminated and requires replacement per the maintenance calendar or following persistent miss-count events.

sop_examples.title: Label Registration Sensor Calibration
sop_examples.condition: The label registration sensor requires calibration due to label-gap detection errors or because the machine has been loaded with a different label stock format.

sop_examples.title: Planned Ribbon Roll Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The ribbon roll has reached scheduled end-of-life during a planned changeover window; the machine is paused and awaiting a fresh ribbon roll before resuming production.

sop_examples.title: Planned Label Roll Changeover
sop_examples.condition: A scheduled product or batch changeover requires swapping the current label roll for a different stock format while stock remains on the current roll.

sop_examples.title: Pneumatic Air Filter Element Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The pneumatic air filter maintenance interval has elapsed, or the filter differential pressure indicator shows a clogged element requiring replacement.

sop_examples.title: Lockout / Tagout Before Maintenance
sop_examples.condition: Maintenance or repair work is about to begin on the labeler, requiring all energy sources to be isolated and physically locked out before any technician enters the machine.

sop_examples.title: Label Adhesive or Solvent Spill Response
sop_examples.condition: Label adhesive or cleaning solvent has spilled on or around the labeler, creating a slip hazard and risk of contamination to nearby parts or equipment.

sop_examples.title: Emergency Stop Activation
sop_examples.condition: A personnel safety hazard, uncontrolled mechanical failure, or fire has been detected in the labeler work area, requiring immediate full machine shutdown.

sop_examples.title: Shift Startup Sequence
sop_examples.condition: The start of a production shift or a machine restart after extended downtime requires a systematic pre-run check before label application begins.

sop_examples.title: End-of-Shift Shutdown Sequence
sop_examples.condition: The production shift has ended and the labeler must be powered down in the correct sequence to prevent damage and prepare the machine for the next shift.

sop_examples.title: Print Quality and Barcode Verification
sop_examples.condition: A scheduled quality check interval has been reached, or a new batch start requires confirming that print quality and barcode readability meet specification before full-rate production.

sop_examples.title: Assist Gas Supply Pressure Below Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: Assist gas supply pressure drifts below the 8 bar operating setpoint and the low-pressure alarm activates.

sop_examples.title: Assist Gas Pressure Sudden Collapse
sop_examples.condition: Assist gas pressure drops instantaneously to below 2 bar, indicating a line rupture or catastrophic regulator failure.

sop_examples.title: Assist Gas Pressure Above Maximum Ceiling
sop_examples.condition: Assist gas pressure exceeds the 16 bar maximum ceiling and the high-pressure alarm activates.

sop_examples.title: Chiller Coolant Temperature Elevated Warning
sop_examples.condition: Chiller coolant outlet temperature rises above the 22 degrees C warning threshold during normal operation.

sop_examples.title: Chiller Coolant Temperature Critical Emergency Stop
sop_examples.condition: Chiller coolant temperature exceeds the 28 degrees C emergency limit, creating imminent risk of laser module thermal damage.

sop_examples.title: Chiller Coolant Reservoir Level Below Minimum
sop_examples.condition: Chiller coolant reservoir level drops below the minimum mark and the low-level sensor activates while temperature remains within range.

sop_examples.title: Cutting Head Collision Sensor Fault Response
sop_examples.condition: The cutting head collision sensor trips after the nozzle makes unintended contact with the workpiece, fixture, or clamp during a cutting cycle.

sop_examples.title: Laser Output Power Below Programmed Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: Measured laser output power falls below 90 percent of the programmed setpoint during an active cutting cycle with no module fault code present.

sop_examples.title: Laser Power Module Fault Complete Emission Failure
sop_examples.condition: The laser power module generates a fault code and emission stops entirely with zero output detected and no cutting occurring.

sop_examples.title: Fume Exhaust System Airflow Below Minimum
sop_examples.condition: Fume exhaust system airflow drops below the 800 CFM minimum threshold and the airflow sensor alarm activates.

sop_examples.title: Focus Lens Scheduled Replacement
sop_examples.condition: Focus lens replacement interval has been reached per the PM calendar, or lens damage is confirmed during optical inspection.

sop_examples.title: Cutting Nozzle Inspection and Cleaning
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled nozzle inspection interval is reached or cut quality degradation is observed on finished parts.

sop_examples.title: Cutting Head Protective Cover Glass Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The protective cover glass inside the cutting head reaches its replacement interval or shows visible contamination on inspection.

sop_examples.title: Chiller Coolant Scheduled Monthly Refill
sop_examples.condition: Monthly PM calendar triggers a scheduled coolant top-off with no active sensor alarm and coolant level still above the low threshold.

sop_examples.title: Fume Exhaust Filter Replacement
sop_examples.condition: Exhaust filter differential pressure exceeds 1.5 in-WC or the PM interval is reached, indicating filter saturation.

sop_examples.title: Laser Power and Focus Calibration
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled calibration interval is due or post-maintenance verification is required after optic service.

sop_examples.title: X and Y Axis Linear Guide Rail Lubrication
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled lubrication interval for X and Y axis linear guide rails is reached per the PM calendar.

sop_examples.title: Laser Cutter Lockout Tagout Energy Isolation
sop_examples.condition: Maintenance or repair work requires full energy isolation of the laser cutter before personnel enter the enclosure or service internal components.

sop_examples.title: Chiller Coolant Spill Cleanup Response
sop_examples.condition: Chiller coolant is observed spilled on the floor around the laser cutter or chiller unit.

sop_examples.title: Fire or Uncontrolled Combustion Emergency Stop
sop_examples.condition: Fire, uncontrolled smoke, or sustained sparking is detected inside or immediately adjacent to the laser cutting enclosure.
