sop_examples.title: Laser Cutter Shift Startup Sequence
sop_examples.condition: Laser cutter is to be started at the beginning of a shift or following a planned shutdown.

sop_examples.title: Laser Cutter End of Shift Shutdown Sequence
sop_examples.condition: Laser cutter is to be shut down at the end of a shift or before a planned maintenance window.

sop_examples.title: Gradual Pressure Decay Below Setpoint During Hold
sop_examples.condition: Chamber pressure declines steadily below the hold-phase setpoint over 30 or more seconds, indicating a slow continuous leak through the part or a degraded seal interface.

sop_examples.title: Sudden Pressure Collapse Mid-Test Cycle
sop_examples.condition: Chamber pressure drops abruptly from the full hold value to below 10 percent of setpoint within three seconds during an active test cycle, indicating a catastrophic event rather than a slow drift.

sop_examples.title: Overpressure Exceedance During Fill Phase
sop_examples.condition: Pressure transducer reads above the upper test limit while the station is still in the pressurization fill phase, before the stabilization window has opened.

sop_examples.title: Pressure Fails to Reach Minimum Fill Target
sop_examples.condition: After the fill phase timer expires, chamber pressure is still below the minimum test threshold, preventing the hold phase from starting due to insufficient fill from supply or a large part leak.

sop_examples.title: Seal Condition Warning — Marginal Deformation Detected
sop_examples.condition: The seal condition sensor reports marginal deformation on one sealing element while the measured pressure loss rate remains within the upper band of acceptable tolerance, triggering a caution-level warning rather than a test abort.

sop_examples.title: Catastrophic Seal Rupture During Active Pressurization
sop_examples.condition: The seal condition sensor reports a critical failure state and chamber pressure simultaneously collapses to zero within one second of the failure signal, indicating a full structural breach of the sealing assembly under load.

sop_examples.title: Pressure Sensor Calibration Drift Alarm
sop_examples.condition: The primary pressure transducer generates a drift fault code indicating its live output deviates from its last stored calibration reference by more than the allowable tolerance, calling the validity of all recent test readings into question.

sop_examples.title: Part Fixture Mechanical Jam on Engagement or Release Stroke
sop_examples.condition: The fixture position sensor reports that the clamp mechanism failed to complete its engagement or release stroke within the allotted time window, leaving the part unseated or trapped in the fixture.

sop_examples.title: Primary Pressure Sensor Signal Loss Fault
sop_examples.condition: The control system reports complete loss of signal from the primary pressure transducer channel, placing the station in a fault-hold state and suspending all test operations until the signal is restored.

sop_examples.title: Supply-Side Overpressure Relief Valve Activation
sop_examples.condition: An upstream pressure spike causes the pneumatic relief valve on the supply manifold to open and vent to atmosphere, triggering the relief-trip alarm on the station control panel before the test chamber is affected.

sop_examples.title: Scheduled PM Seal Set Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The seal replacement interval counter on the control panel reaches the scheduled preventive maintenance cycle limit, requiring the full seal set to be replaced before the next production test run.

sop_examples.title: Inlet Air Filter Element Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The differential pressure indicator on the inlet filter housing reaches the red zone, or the PM interval timer expires, indicating the filter element must be replaced to restore adequate airflow to the pressurization system.

sop_examples.title: Periodic Pressure Transducer Calibration Verification
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled calibration interval for the primary pressure transducer has elapsed, requiring the sensor output to be verified and adjusted against a traceable reference standard before further production testing.

sop_examples.title: Fixture Clamping Mechanism Lubrication
sop_examples.condition: The lubrication interval counter reaches its PM threshold, or the fixture clamping stroke cycle time increases beyond the acceptable operating range, indicating dry running on the clamp guide rails or actuator.

sop_examples.title: Test Chamber Interior and Seal Face Cleaning
sop_examples.condition: The end-of-week PM schedule is reached, or visible contamination including chips, residue, or debris is observed on the sealing surfaces or chamber interior, requiring cleaning before the next production run.

sop_examples.title: Pressure Regulator Weekly Inspection and Adjustment
sop_examples.condition: Supply pressure to the station deviates from the nominal setting by more than five percent during the weekly inspection walkdown, or following any pressure-related fault event that may have disturbed the regulator.

sop_examples.title: Full Lockout-Tagout for Maintenance Access to Pressurized Components
sop_examples.condition: Planned maintenance requires physical access inside the test chamber or to pressurized fittings and actuators, necessitating full energy isolation and verification of zero-energy state before personnel entry.

sop_examples.title: Pressurized Air Supply Line Disconnection Event
sop_examples.condition: A supply air hose or inlet fitting disconnects or ruptures while under pressure, creating an uncontrolled high-pressure air release with potential for debris scatter and personnel hazard in the station area.

sop_examples.title: Emergency Stop Activation During Live Pressurized Test
sop_examples.condition: An operator or the robot system activates the emergency stop during an active pressurized test cycle due to an immediate observed safety concern that is not covered or not yet detected by the station's automated fault logic.

sop_examples.title: Daily Production Shift Startup Sequence
sop_examples.condition: The beginning of a production shift requires the leak test station to be powered on, supply pressure established, and all sensors and fixtures verified ready before the first part of the day is loaded.

sop_examples.title: End-of-Shift Station Shutdown and Depressurization
sop_examples.condition: The production shift ends and the station must be safely depressurized and powered down in the correct sequence to leave it in a safe state before personnel depart.

sop_examples.title: Controlled Station Restart After Maintenance Lockout Release
sop_examples.condition: Maintenance or a LOTO hold has been completed and all locks cleared, requiring a controlled restart sequence and sensor verification before returning the station to production to confirm integrity of any work performed.

sop_examples.title: Flywheel Speed Below Minimum
sop_examples.condition: Flywheel tachometer reads below 150 RPM during an active production cycle.

sop_examples.title: Flywheel Overspeed Alarm
sop_examples.condition: Flywheel tachometer exceeds 180 RPM, triggering the overspeed alarm relay.

sop_examples.title: Clutch Slip Fault Alarm
sop_examples.condition: Clutch engagement sensor detects greater than 5 percent speed differential slip between the flywheel and the crankshaft.

sop_examples.title: Brake Drag After Clutch Engagement
sop_examples.condition: Crankshaft position encoder confirms the crank is moving but the brake torque sensor shows the brake pad is still partially applied, indicating the brake has not fully released.

sop_examples.title: Workpiece Jam in Die Cavity
sop_examples.condition: Die area proximity sensor detects an obstruction remaining inside the die cavity at the end of the press stroke.

sop_examples.title: Lubrication System Pressure Low
sop_examples.condition: Central lubrication system pressure gauge reads below 40 PSI during active production.

sop_examples.title: Lubrication System Pressure High
sop_examples.condition: Central lubrication system pressure gauge reads above 120 PSI, indicating a blocked distribution line downstream of the pump.

sop_examples.title: Press Tonnage Overload Trip
sop_examples.condition: Tonnage monitor reading exceeds the rated press capacity of 600 tons, triggering the overload relay and halting the press mid-cycle.

sop_examples.title: Forming Tonnage Below Expected Range
sop_examples.condition: Tonnage monitor shows production force below 80 percent of the part-specific forming load setpoint with no overload trip and the press continuing to cycle normally.

sop_examples.title: Crankshaft Position Encoder Fault
sop_examples.condition: Crankshaft position encoder signal is lost or reports an invalid angle reading during a production stroke.

sop_examples.title: Die Cooling Circuit Minor Leak
sop_examples.condition: Coolant level sensor shows a gradual drop of less than 2 percent per hour and a drip is visually confirmed at a die cooling line fitting.

sop_examples.title: Die Cooling Line Rupture Emergency
sop_examples.condition: Coolant flow sensor detects a sudden loss of more than 50 percent of coolant flow within 10 seconds, indicating a catastrophic line rupture.

sop_examples.title: Scheduled Die Lubrication Fluid Change
sop_examples.condition: Die lubrication stroke counter reaches the 500-stroke scheduled replacement interval.

sop_examples.title: Clutch and Brake Friction Pad Inspection
sop_examples.condition: Press cycle counter reaches the 2,000-cycle scheduled inspection interval for clutch and brake friction pad wear.

sop_examples.title: Flywheel V-Belt Inspection and Replacement
sop_examples.condition: Quarterly scheduled maintenance interval for the flywheel drive V-belt inspection and replacement is reached.

sop_examples.title: Lubrication System Filter Replacement
sop_examples.condition: Lubrication filter differential pressure gauge enters the red zone, indicating the filter element is saturated and restricting flow.

sop_examples.title: Crankshaft Bearing Re-Greasing
sop_examples.condition: Accumulated production hours reach the 250-hour scheduled re-greasing interval for crankshaft main bearing grease points.

sop_examples.title: Press Slide Shut Height Calibration
sop_examples.condition: Quality measurement data shows part thickness variation exceeding plus or minus 0.15 mm across 50 consecutive parts, indicating slide shut height drift.

sop_examples.title: Press Lockout-Tagout for Die Change
sop_examples.condition: A die change work order is issued requiring full energy isolation of the press before personnel access the tooling area.

sop_examples.title: Hydraulic Counterbalance Fluid Spill Response
sop_examples.condition: Hydraulic fluid from the counterbalance cylinder circuit is detected pooling on the press floor area.

sop_examples.title: Fire Alarm or Emergency Stop Chain Response
sop_examples.condition: Plant fire alarm activates or the press emergency stop safety chain is broken during active production.

sop_examples.title: Press Cold Start Startup Procedure
sop_examples.condition: Beginning-of-shift startup is required for a press that has been fully de-energized for more than four hours.

sop_examples.title: Booth Differential Pressure Below Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: The booth differential pressure sensor reads below the 0.05 inch WC lower setpoint during an active spray cycle, indicating insufficient negative-pressure draw.

sop_examples.title: Sudden Booth Pressure Collapse
sop_examples.condition: The booth differential pressure drops from a normal reading to zero or negative within ten seconds, indicating exhaust fan failure or a major duct breach rather than a gradual drift.

sop_examples.title: Booth Differential Pressure Above Upper Ceiling
sop_examples.condition: The booth differential pressure sensor reads above the 0.15 inch WC upper ceiling, indicating a partially obstructed exhaust path or over-pressurized makeup air supply.

sop_examples.title: Atomizer Air Supply Pressure Below Minimum
sop_examples.condition: The atomizer air pressure sensor reads below 60 PSI during an active spray cycle, risking poor droplet atomization and coat defects on the workpiece.

sop_examples.title: Minor Solvent Seep at Tank Fitting
sop_examples.condition: A slow drip or seep of solvent is observed at a tank fitting or hose connection with estimated volume below 0.5 gallons and no vapor alarm activation, requiring containment without emergency evacuation.

sop_examples.title: Major Solvent Release — Fire and Vapor Hazard
sop_examples.condition: A large uncontrolled solvent release exceeding 0.5 gallons is detected with the vapor alarm active, presenting an immediate fire and inhalation hazard that requires emergency response and evacuation.

sop_examples.title: Partial Spray Tip Blockage — Reduced Fan Pattern
sop_examples.condition: The spray pattern sensor detects a narrowed or asymmetric fan pattern consistent with a partially obstructed spray tip orifice, while the flow meter still shows non-zero paint delivery.

sop_examples.title: Complete Spray Tip Blockage — Zero Flow Output
sop_examples.condition: The flow meter reads zero output at the spray applicator tip while pump pressure remains nominal, indicating the tip orifice is fully blocked and the tip must be replaced rather than cleared.

sop_examples.title: Exhaust Filter Differential Pressure — First-Stage Warning
sop_examples.condition: The exhaust filter differential pressure sensor reads between 0.80 and 0.95 inch WC, entering the first-stage warning band that signals a planned filter change is needed within the next shift; production may continue.

sop_examples.title: Exhaust Filter Differential Pressure — Emergency Alarm Level
sop_examples.condition: The exhaust filter differential pressure exceeds the 0.95 inch WC emergency threshold, causing critically restricted airflow that requires immediate production stop and fan shutdown rather than a scheduled change.

sop_examples.title: Scheduled Exhaust Filter Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The maintenance schedule or a prior first-stage warning alert requires replacement of the exhaust particulate filter during a planned downtime window.

sop_examples.title: Scheduled Intake Air Filter Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The maintenance schedule requires replacement of the makeup-air intake filter to maintain clean particle-free air supply to the booth interior.

sop_examples.title: Scheduled Spray Atomizer Bell Cup Cleaning
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled atomizer cleaning interval has been reached, or a quality inspection identifies dried paint buildup on the bell cup surface that could cause defects on subsequent parts.

sop_examples.title: Scheduled Paint Pump Lubrication
sop_examples.condition: The preventive maintenance schedule indicates the paint supply pump is due for lubrication of its piston seals and bearing races.

sop_examples.title: Spray Pattern Calibration Verification
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled calibration interval for spray tip fan angle and flow rate has been reached, or film thickness readings show deviation across the width of the target surface indicating pattern drift.

sop_examples.title: Lockout-Tagout Before Booth Maintenance Entry
sop_examples.condition: Planned or corrective maintenance requires a technician to physically enter the booth enclosure; all electrical, pneumatic, and paint-supply energy sources must be isolated, locked, and tagged before entry.

sop_examples.title: Fire Alarm or Emergency Stop During Spray Operation
sop_examples.condition: A fire alarm activates within the booth enclosure or an operator manually triggers the emergency stop while paint is actively being sprayed, requiring immediate suppression and evacuation.

sop_examples.title: Paint Pooling on Booth Floor During Coating Operation
sop_examples.condition: Liquid paint is observed accumulating on the booth floor during an active coating cycle without evidence of a tank rupture, indicating a drip-line disconnection or overspray accumulation that requires containment without emergency evacuation.

sop_examples.title: Beginning-of-Shift Paint Booth Startup
sop_examples.condition: The paint booth is in a fully shut-down state at the start of a production shift and must be brought to operational readiness through a sequenced energization and verification routine.

sop_examples.title: End-of-Shift Paint Booth Shutdown
sop_examples.condition: The production shift has ended and the paint booth must be safely brought to a fully de-energized state before personnel leave the area.

sop_examples.title: Paint Film Thickness Below Minimum Specification
sop_examples.condition: The film thickness gauge reads below the 60-micron minimum specification on one or more measurement spots of a coated part, indicating insufficient paint deposition that will fail corrosion protection requirements.

sop_examples.title: Pre-Shift Paint Viscosity Out of Specification
sop_examples.condition: The pre-shift viscosity check shows paint outside the 18-22 second Ford Cup No. 4 specification range, indicating incorrect solvent ratio or temperature that will cause spray defects if the run proceeds.

sop_examples.title: Gripper Suction Pressure Below Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: Vacuum level on the gripper suction circuit reads below 45 kPa during a pick cycle, triggering a sustained low-vacuum alarm without complete loss of grip.

sop_examples.title: Mid-Cycle Gripper Vacuum Total Loss
sop_examples.condition: Vacuum pressure on the gripper drops instantaneously to zero while a carton is actively held mid-transfer, triggering an immediate drop-fault interlock and halting all motion.

sop_examples.title: Gripper Suction Pressure Exceeds Maximum Threshold
sop_examples.condition: Vacuum level on the gripper suction circuit reads above 80 kPa, indicating the vacuum regulator or pressure-relief valve is stuck closed and over-pulling on carton surfaces.

sop_examples.title: Pallet Dispenser Feed Jam
sop_examples.condition: A pallet fails to separate cleanly from the magazine stack and the pallet-present sensor at the staging position does not confirm within the 30-second timeout window.

sop_examples.title: Carton Infeed Conveyor Jam
sop_examples.condition: The infeed conveyor jam sensor detects a blocked product flow for more than 5 consecutive seconds, stopping the palletizer cycle while upstream conveyor continues to run.

sop_examples.title: Safety Fence Zone Intrusion Warning
sop_examples.condition: A safety light curtain or gate-position switch detects partial or momentary entry into the robot work envelope and issues a warning-level alert without triggering a full emergency stop.

sop_examples.title: Safety Fence Emergency Stop Activation
sop_examples.condition: A guard door is forcibly opened or the safety relay detects a dual-channel fault, triggering an emergency stop that locks out all robot motion until a deliberate reset sequence is completed.

sop_examples.title: Robot Arm Servo Drive Electrical Fault
sop_examples.condition: The robot controller reports a servo drive overcurrent or encoder feedback error fault code on any axis, halting all robot arm motion and illuminating a drive fault LED.

sop_examples.title: PLC-to-Robot Communication Loss
sop_examples.condition: The palletizer PLC reports a loss of EtherNet/IP connection to the robot controller, causing the palletizer system to enter a faulted idle state with no motion and no alarm sound.

sop_examples.title: Vacuum Pump Over-Temperature Warning
sop_examples.condition: The vacuum pump thermal sensor reads above 95 degrees C, generating a warning-level caution that allows the current pick cycle to finish but forces a mandatory cooldown pause before the next cycle begins.

sop_examples.title: Vacuum Inlet Filter Scheduled Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The 500-hour PM interval is reached, or the differential pressure sensor across the vacuum inlet filter reads above 15 kPa, indicating a filter loaded with carton dust that is starving the pump.

sop_examples.title: Robot Arm Joint Lubrication Scheduled Service
sop_examples.condition: The 2000-hour greasing interval is due, or audible bearing noise is detected from any robot arm joint during an automatic cycle, requiring grease application to all six joints.

sop_examples.title: Suction Cup Wear Inspection and Replacement
sop_examples.condition: A drop-event count exceeds 3 per 1000 pick cycles, or visual inspection reveals cracked, torn, or hardened suction cups on the end-of-arm tool.

sop_examples.title: Pallet Dispenser Drive Chain Lubrication
sop_examples.condition: The weekly maintenance schedule requires lubrication of the pallet dispenser drive chain, or the chain emits a chattering or ticking noise at the start of a pallet-drop cycle.

sop_examples.title: Safety Fence Light Curtain Calibration
sop_examples.condition: The quarterly calibration schedule is due, or the light curtain self-test reports a marginal receiver signal strength that could produce false zone-clear readings.

sop_examples.title: End-of-Arm Tool Deep Cleaning
sop_examples.condition: End-of-shift or product changeover requires removal of carton dust, adhesive residue, and debris accumulated on the gripper face plate and suction cup lips.

sop_examples.title: Palletizer Lockout-Tagout for Maintenance Entry
sop_examples.condition: A maintenance task requires a technician to physically enter the robot work envelope, mandating full electrical and pneumatic energy isolation before personnel entry.

sop_examples.title: Hydraulic Fluid or Grease Spill Response
sop_examples.condition: A visible pool or smear of oil, grease, or hydraulic fluid is discovered on the floor inside or immediately adjacent to the palletizer work cell.

sop_examples.title: Emergency Stop Response and System Recovery
sop_examples.condition: Any hardwired e-stop button on the palletizer cell has been pressed, cutting power to all motion axes and requiring a deliberate, inspected reset sequence before restart.

sop_examples.title: Daily Palletizer Startup Procedure
sop_examples.condition: Start-of-shift power-up is required to bring the palletizer from a fully de-energized overnight state to full automatic production mode with all safety interlocks confirmed.

sop_examples.title: End-of-Shift Palletizer Shutdown
sop_examples.condition: Production shift ends and the palletizer must be safely powered down with the robot arm returned to home position, all conveyors cleared, and the main disconnect opened.

sop_examples.title: Completed Pallet Load Pattern Quality Inspection
sop_examples.condition: The robot has completed building a full pallet and the load must be inspected for layer alignment, carton orientation, and overall stack stability before the pallet exits to the stretch wrapper.

sop_examples.title: Wash Pressure Gradually Below Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: The wash zone pressure sensor reads below 15 PSI while the pump is running at commanded speed, indicating a gradual loss of hydraulic output.

sop_examples.title: Wash Pressure Exceeds Upper Limit
sop_examples.condition: The wash zone pressure sensor reads above 45 PSI, indicating a restriction or blockage in the downstream flow path.

sop_examples.title: Sudden Complete Loss of Wash Pressure
sop_examples.condition: Wash pressure drops from normal operating range to zero or near-zero within a single machine cycle while the pump remains energized and all other controls show no fault.

sop_examples.title: Wash Solution Temperature Below Minimum
sop_examples.condition: The tank thermocouple reads below 140 degrees F during a production run while the heater is indicated as active, signaling insufficient heat output.

sop_examples.title: Wash Solution Temperature Exceeds Safe Limit
sop_examples.condition: The tank thermocouple reads above 185 degrees F, triggering the high-temperature alarm on the control panel and creating steam vapor risk.

sop_examples.title: Wash Tank Solution Level Low Alarm
sop_examples.condition: The float-type level sensor in the wash tank activates the low-level alarm, indicating solution has dropped below 60 percent of rated capacity and pump cavitation is imminent.

sop_examples.title: Spray Nozzle Obstruction Fault
sop_examples.condition: One or more spray nozzles show zero flow output while the pump is running at normal pressure, indicating a physical blockage inside the nozzle orifice.

sop_examples.title: Wash Pump Motor Overload Fault
sop_examples.condition: The pump motor overload relay trips and the fault indicator illuminates on the main control panel, halting pump operation.

sop_examples.title: Scheduled Filter Cartridge Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The filter differential pressure gauge reads above 10 PSI or the 500-hour replacement interval has elapsed, whichever occurs first.

sop_examples.title: Routine Scheduled Spray Nozzle Cleaning
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled weekly maintenance interval requires inspection and mechanical cleaning of all spray nozzles to remove mineral scale before obstruction occurs.

sop_examples.title: Monthly Tank Drain and Interior Cleaning
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled monthly maintenance requires full tank drain, sludge removal, and interior surface cleaning to prevent contamination carryover into the wash bath.

sop_examples.title: Wash Solution Concentration Replenishment
sop_examples.condition: Titration or conductivity measurement confirms detergent concentration has fallen below the 3 percent minimum specification and requires chemical addition to restore efficacy.

sop_examples.title: Wash Pump Bearing Lubrication Service
sop_examples.condition: The 1000-hour scheduled maintenance interval requires lubrication of wash pump motor bearings to prevent premature wear.

sop_examples.title: Parts Conveyor Belt Replacement
sop_examples.condition: Visual inspection identifies a torn, frayed, or excessively stretched conveyor belt that fails monthly wear-check acceptance criteria.

sop_examples.title: Lockout Tagout Before Maintenance Entry
sop_examples.condition: Any maintenance activity requiring physical entry into the wash enclosure or contact with internal components must be preceded by full energy isolation per LOTO procedure.

sop_examples.title: Wash Solution Spill Response
sop_examples.condition: Wash solution is observed pooling on the floor around the machine base or flowing beyond the containment berm boundary.

sop_examples.title: Detergent Concentrate Day Tank Overfill
sop_examples.condition: The high-level alarm on the detergent concentrate day tank activates because the automated fill sequence has filled the tank above safe capacity.

sop_examples.title: Emergency Stop Activation and Recovery
sop_examples.condition: An emergency stop button has been pressed on the machine, halting all conveyor motion and pump operation and requiring controlled reset before production can resume.

sop_examples.title: Daily Machine Startup Sequence
sop_examples.condition: The machine has been idle overnight or across a shift change and requires a full controlled startup, including bath warm-up verification, before parts may be loaded.

sop_examples.title: End-of-Shift Shutdown Sequence
sop_examples.condition: Production has ended for the shift and the machine must be shut down in the correct sequence to prevent pump dry-run damage and solution degradation.

sop_examples.title: Post-Wash Parts Cleanliness Inspection
sop_examples.condition: A sample lot of washed parts must be inspected for residual oil film, particulate, or water spots before advancing to the next downstream operation.

sop_examples.title: Daily Wash Solution Concentration Verification
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled daily quality check requires sampling the bath and confirming detergent concentration remains within the 3 to 6 percent specification band before production begins.

sop_examples.title: Plasma Gas Pressure Below Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: The plasma supply gas pressure sensor reads below the minimum operating setpoint of 85 PSI, triggering a low-pressure warning alarm.
steps: notify shift_supervisor if pressure remains below 85 PSI

sop_examples.title: Plasma Gas Pressure Above Ceiling
sop_examples.condition: The plasma supply gas pressure sensor reads above the maximum safe limit of 120 PSI, triggering an over-pressure alarm requiring immediate gas supply isolation.

sop_examples.title: Sudden Plasma Gas Pressure Collapse
sop_examples.condition: The plasma supply gas pressure sensor drops from operating range to below 20 PSI within 5 seconds, indicating a catastrophic supply failure or line rupture requiring immediate machine stop.

sop_examples.title: Torch Height Below Minimum Pierce Distance
sop_examples.condition: The torch height controller sensor reads a standoff distance below 0.06 inches during piercing, indicating the torch is dangerously close to the workpiece and at risk of contact.
steps: notify operator if standoff height is not restored to specification

sop_examples.title: Torch Height Above Maximum Cutting Distance
sop_examples.condition: The torch height controller sensor reads a standoff distance above 0.25 inches during cutting, causing the arc to stretch, degrade cut edge quality, and increase dross formation.
steps: notify operator if standoff height is not corrected to specification

sop_examples.title: Plasma Torch Coolant Temperature High
sop_examples.condition: The coolant temperature sensor on the plasma power supply reads above 45 degrees C, triggering a thermal warning that may cause the unit to derate output or shut down to prevent damage.

sop_examples.title: Arc Transfer Failure Fault
sop_examples.condition: The plasma cutter displays an arc transfer fault after three consecutive failed pilot arc ignition attempts, halting the cut program due to failure to establish a transferred arc on the workpiece.

sop_examples.title: Gantry Drive Motor Fault
sop_examples.condition: The X- or Y-axis servo drive controller reports a motor stall or encoder fault, stopping all gantry motion mid-cut and requiring a drive fault reset before motion can resume.

sop_examples.title: Plasma Torch Consumable Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The arc-on hours counter reaches the consumable replacement threshold of 3 hours, or post-cut inspection shows excessive dross and irregular kerf indicating worn electrode or nozzle.
steps: notify operator when consumable exchange is complete

sop_examples.title: Downdraft Filter Cartridge Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The downdraft pressure differential sensor reads a drop greater than 1.5 inches WC above baseline, indicating a clogged filter cartridge that is reducing fume extraction capacity.

sop_examples.title: Linear Rail and Rack Lubrication
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled maintenance counter reaches 40 cutting hours, requiring lubrication of the X- and Y-axis linear rails and rack-and-pinion drive to prevent wear and binding.

sop_examples.title: Torch Height Controller Calibration
sop_examples.condition: The torch height controller reports a calibration drift alarm, or post-cut inspection shows inconsistent standoff height across the cutting envelope requiring a full THC recalibration.
steps: notify operator when calibration sequence is complete

sop_examples.title: Water Table Drain and Clean
sop_examples.condition: The water table level sensor indicates accumulated slag and debris exceeding the 2-inch threshold above the slat surface, or the scheduled 80-hour maintenance interval is reached.
steps: notify operator when table drain and clean is complete

sop_examples.title: Plasma Gas Supply Line Inspection
sop_examples.condition: The routine 30-day inspection interval is reached, or a low-level gas odor is detected near the plasma cutting table requiring a physical leak check of all supply line fittings.

sop_examples.title: Lockout Tagout Energy Isolation
sop_examples.condition: A maintenance task requiring physical access to the plasma torch, gantry, power supply, or any energized component is initiated, requiring full energy isolation before work begins.

sop_examples.title: Fire or Smoke on Cutting Table Response
sop_examples.condition: The smoke detector activates or an operator observes active flame or heavy smoke rising from the cutting table, slat bed, or downdraft system during or after a cut cycle.

sop_examples.title: Emergency Stop Activation and Reset
sop_examples.condition: An emergency stop button is pressed due to a personnel hazard or unexpected machine motion requiring immediate halt of all gantry motion and plasma arc, followed by a controlled reset after the hazard is cleared.
steps: notify operator when machine is cleared to resume

sop_examples.title: Coolant or Water Spill Response
sop_examples.condition: Coolant or water is observed pooling on the floor near the plasma cutting table, creating a slip hazard and potential electrical risk to floor-level cables and conduit.

sop_examples.title: Daily Machine Startup Sequence
sop_examples.condition: Beginning of production shift requiring the plasma cutter to be brought from de-energized state to fully operational ready-to-cut status with all systems verified.
steps: notify operator when system is ready for production

sop_examples.title: End of Shift Shutdown Sequence
sop_examples.condition: End of production shift requiring the plasma cutter to be brought from operational state to safely de-energized and gas-isolated state before personnel leave the area.

sop_examples.title: Post-Cut Quality Inspection
sop_examples.condition: A completed cut nest requires inspection for dross adhesion, kerf width deviation, and edge angularity before parts are released to the next downstream operation.

sop_examples.title: Torch Perpendicularity and Alignment Verification
sop_examples.condition: Post-maintenance inspection or a torch crash event requires verification that the torch body is perpendicular to the cutting table and correctly aligned to the machine datum point before production resumes.
steps: notify operator with alignment verification result

sop_examples.title: Cure Zone Temperature Below Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: Zone temperature sensor reads more than 10°F below the cure setpoint for over 5 consecutive minutes with no sudden rate-of-change.
steps: read_sensor zone_1_temp_sensor and note degrees of deviation from setpoint
read_sensor gas_pressure_sensor to verify adequate fuel supply
press_button burner_boost_button to increase burner heat output
wait 120 seconds for temperature to recover
read_sensor zone_1_temp_sensor and notify shift_supervisor if reading remains below setpoint

sop_examples.title: Sudden Cure Zone Temperature Collapse
sop_examples.condition: Zone temperature sensor drops more than 50°F within a 2-minute window, indicating an abrupt burner failure rather than gradual drift.
steps: read_sensor zone_1_temp_sensor to confirm rate-of-drop and rule out sensor glitch
press_button burner_estop_button to safely shut down the failed burner
notify maintenance_lead of burner failure and temperature reading
press_button conveyor_hold_button to halt product flow into the cold zone
read_sensor zone_1_temp_sensor after 30 seconds to confirm burner is fully off

sop_examples.title: Cure Zone Temperature Above Maximum Ceiling
sop_examples.condition: Zone temperature sensor reads above the absolute maximum cure ceiling of 400°F, risking coating over-cure and part damage.
steps: read_sensor zone_1_temp_sensor to confirm over-ceiling reading and record value
press_button burner_shutoff_button to cut heat immediately
wait 60 seconds for temperature to begin declining
read_sensor zone_1_temp_sensor to confirm downward trend
notify quality_inspector to place hold on all parts currently in-process
notify shift_supervisor with recorded temperature peak and timestamp

sop_examples.title: Burner Fails to Ignite on Startup
sop_examples.condition: The burner ignition sequence completes but the flame sensor reports no flame established after two automatic attempts.
steps: read_sensor flame_sensor to confirm absence of ignition signal
press_button burner_reset_button to clear the ignition lockout
wait 15 seconds for safety purge cycle to complete
press_button burner_ignite_button to initiate a fresh ignition sequence
read_sensor flame_sensor to verify flame is now established
notify maintenance_lead if flame_sensor still reads no-flame after retry

sop_examples.title: Conveyor Running Below Target Speed
sop_examples.condition: Conveyor speed sensor reads more than 15% below the programmed cure-time setpoint speed for over 3 minutes while the belt is still moving.
steps: read_sensor conveyor_speed_sensor to confirm below-setpoint reading and record value
press_button speed_increase_button to bump the conveyor drive frequency
wait 60 seconds for speed to stabilize
read_sensor conveyor_speed_sensor to verify speed has recovered
notify shift_supervisor if speed remains below setpoint after adjustment
notify maintenance_lead to inspect conveyor drive motor and gearbox

sop_examples.title: Conveyor Fully Stopped Mid-Run
sop_examples.condition: Conveyor motion sensor reads zero speed while the drive is commanded to run, indicating a hard jam or drive fault with belt completely stationary.
steps: read_sensor conveyor_motion_sensor to confirm complete stoppage
press_button conveyor_estop_button to cut power to the drive motor
notify maintenance_lead and shift_supervisor of full conveyor stoppage
read_sensor jam_sensor to identify obstruction location
notify line_lead that oven contents are at risk and conveyor is safe to inspect

sop_examples.title: Exhaust Duct Pressure Below Warning Threshold
sop_examples.condition: Exhaust duct static pressure reads below the minimum warning threshold, suggesting gradual fan degradation or filter loading, but not yet at alarm level.
steps: read_sensor exhaust_pressure_sensor to confirm below-warning reading and record value
read_sensor exhaust_filter_indicator to assess filter loading status
notify maintenance_lead with pressure reading and filter indicator status
press_button exhaust_fan_boost_button to attempt temporary pressure recovery
wait 90 seconds for system to respond
read_sensor exhaust_pressure_sensor to determine if pressure has recovered or continues declining

sop_examples.title: Exhaust Duct Pressure Above High-Pressure Alarm
sop_examples.condition: Exhaust duct static pressure exceeds the high-pressure alarm setpoint, indicating downstream duct blockage or damper fault causing back-pressure.
steps: read_sensor exhaust_pressure_sensor to confirm high-pressure alarm reading
press_button exhaust_fan_shutoff_button to prevent motor overload from back-pressure
notify maintenance_lead and shift_supervisor of high exhaust pressure alarm
read_sensor exhaust_duct_sensor to identify blockage or damper fault location
notify line_lead to hold production until exhaust is restored

sop_examples.title: Minor Gas Leak or Odor Detected
sop_examples.condition: Gas concentration sensor reads above background baseline but below the emergency alarm threshold (under 25% LEL), or an operator reports a faint gas odor.
steps: read_sensor gas_concentration_sensor to confirm above-baseline but sub-alarm reading
press_button ventilation_boost_button to increase area airflow and dilute concentration
notify maintenance_lead with exact sensor reading
read_sensor gas_pressure_sensor to check for pressure drop suggesting an active leak
notify shift_supervisor and await maintenance inspection before resuming production

sop_examples.title: Major Gas Leak Emergency Alarm
sop_examples.condition: Gas concentration sensor triggers the high-level emergency alarm at or above 25% LEL, indicating a large and immediately dangerous gas release.
steps: press_button gas_emergency_shutoff_button to cut all gas supply to the oven row
press_button main_estop_button to eliminate all ignition sources
notify safety_officer and shift_supervisor of high-LEL gas alarm immediately
notify evacuation_coordinator to begin immediate area evacuation
wait at_safe_assembly_point for emergency response team arrival

sop_examples.title: Exhaust Filter Media Replacement
sop_examples.condition: Exhaust filter differential pressure sensor reaches the established replacement threshold or the scheduled PM interval has been reached.
steps: read_sensor filter_dp_sensor to confirm differential pressure at or above replacement threshold
read_sensor filter_dp_sensor to confirm restored normal differential pressure

sop_examples.title: Conveyor Belt Inspection and Tension Check
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled weekly inspection interval has been reached or a belt-tracking alarm has been triggered indicating lateral drift.
steps: read_sensor belt_tension_sensor to record current tension value
read_sensor belt_tracking_sensor to check for lateral drift off-center
read_sensor conveyor_speed_sensor to verify drive sprocket engagement and condition
notify maintenance_lead with tension and tracking readings for evaluation
notify shift_supervisor if any reading is outside the established specification range

sop_examples.title: Burner Nozzle Cleaning
sop_examples.condition: Monthly PM schedule interval has been reached or burner combustion efficiency sensor shows degraded flame quality below target.
steps: press_button burner_shutoff_button to extinguish flame and verify via flame_sensor
wait 300 seconds for burner assembly to cool to safe handling temperature
place nozzle_cleaning_tool at burner_nozzle_location to clean carbon and scale deposits
notify maintenance_lead that nozzle cleaning is complete and ready for restart

sop_examples.title: Zone Thermocouple Calibration Check
sop_examples.condition: Quarterly calibration schedule is due or a temperature deviation flag has been raised during a quality audit.
steps: wait 120 seconds for thermal equilibration between probe and environment
read_sensor zone_1_temp_sensor and compare displayed value to calibration_reference_display
notify quality_inspector with the measured deviation in degrees
notify maintenance_lead if deviation exceeds the allowed tolerance of ±2°F

sop_examples.title: Conveyor Chain Lubrication
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled weekly lubrication interval has been reached or operator reports chain squealing or dry-running noise from the conveyor.
steps: place lube_applicator at conveyor_chain to apply lubricant along full accessible length
wait 30 seconds for lubricant to distribute into chain links
read_sensor conveyor_speed_sensor to confirm smooth chain engagement
notify maintenance_lead with lubrication service completion record

sop_examples.title: Full Oven Lockout Tagout Procedure
sop_examples.condition: Maintenance or repair work requiring physical access to energized oven components necessitates complete de-energization of all oven energy sources.
steps: notify shift_supervisor to obtain authorization before beginning LOTO
press_button main_power_shutoff_button to de-energize all oven electrical systems
place loto_lock on main_electrical_disconnect_hasp to secure against re-energization
place loto_tag on gas_shutoff_valve to identify and block gas energy source

sop_examples.title: Fire or Flame-Outside-Combustion-Zone Emergency Stop
sop_examples.condition: A fire alarm activates in the oven area or an operator observes visible flames outside the designated combustion chamber.
steps: press_button red_fire_estop_button to simultaneously cut all electrical power and gas supply
notify safety_officer and shift_supervisor of fire event and location
notify evacuation_coordinator to initiate immediate area evacuation
wait at safe_assembly_point for emergency response team arrival

sop_examples.title: Chemical or Oil Spill Near Oven
sop_examples.condition: An oil, solvent, or chemical spill is detected on the floor in the oven area, creating a slip and fire hazard near an ignition source.
steps: notify shift_supervisor of spill location and estimated size
place spill_absorbent over spill_area to contain and absorb the liquid
pick used_absorbent from floor after absorption is complete
notify safety_officer with spill type estimate, quantity, and cleanup status

sop_examples.title: Normal Oven Startup from Cold Idle
sop_examples.condition: Oven is in cold idle state and production schedule requires bringing the cure oven to full operating temperature for the shift.
steps: press_button main_power_on_button to energize all oven systems and controls
press_button burner_ignite_button to begin the automated ignition sequence
wait 300 seconds for oven to reach operating temperature
read_sensor zone_1_temp_sensor to confirm setpoint temperature has been achieved
notify shift_supervisor that oven is at setpoint and ready for production loading

sop_examples.title: Normal Oven Shutdown to Safe Idle
sop_examples.condition: Production run is complete and the oven must be taken to a safe cooled-idle or end-of-shift state.
steps: press_button burner_shutoff_button to extinguish all burners
wait 600 seconds for oven interior to cool below safe access threshold
read_sensor zone_1_temp_sensor to confirm temperature is below 150°F
press_button conveyor_off_button to stop conveyor drive
notify shift_supervisor that oven shutdown is complete and confirmed safe

sop_examples.title: Post-Cure Coating Quality Inspection
sop_examples.condition: Parts have exited the cure oven and require quality verification of coating adhesion and uniformity before release to assembly.
steps: read_sensor cure_uniformity_sensor to evaluate coating adhesion and color consistency
notify quality_inspector with sensor reading and visual observations
place inspection_sample in approved_parts_bin or reject_parts_bin based on quality_inspector disposition

sop_examples.title: Conveyor Speed Calibration Verification
sop_examples.condition: Monthly calibration interval is due or a quality audit has noted cure time deviations suggesting the speed display does not match actual belt speed.
steps: read_sensor conveyor_speed_sensor to record the currently displayed belt speed
place tachometer at conveyor_drive_shaft to independently measure actual shaft speed
wait 30 seconds for tachometer reading to stabilize
read_sensor tachometer_display and compare measured value to conveyor_speed_sensor displayed value
notify maintenance_lead with calibration deviation result for correction or logging

sop_examples.title: Low Hydraulic Pressure During Bend Cycle
sop_examples.condition: The hydraulic_pressure_sensor reads below 180 bar while the ram is executing an active bend stroke.
steps: Read hydraulic_pressure_sensor to confirm sub-180 bar reading
Press red_estop_button to halt the ram immediately
Read hydraulic_oil_level_sensor to check for a fluid deficit contributing to low pressure
Notify maintenance_supervisor with the current hydraulic_pressure_sensor and hydraulic_oil_level_sensor readings

sop_examples.title: Hydraulic Pressure Exceeds Safe Ceiling
sop_examples.condition: The hydraulic_pressure_sensor reads above 220 bar during or between bend strokes, indicating an overpressure condition in the hydraulic circuit.
steps: Read hydraulic_pressure_sensor to confirm above-220 bar reading
Press hydraulic_pump_stop_button to de-energize the pump and allow natural pressure decay
Wait 60 seconds for system pressure to dissipate through the relief valve
Read hydraulic_pressure_sensor again to verify pressure has fallen below 200 bar
Notify maintenance_supervisor if pressure remains above 200 bar after 60 seconds

sop_examples.title: Sudden Hydraulic Pressure Collapse Mid-Stroke
sop_examples.condition: The hydraulic_pressure_sensor drops from operating range to below 50 bar within one stroke second, indicating a catastrophic line rupture or major seal failure accompanied by visible fluid loss.
steps: Walk to press_brake_control_panel and press red_estop_button immediately to freeze all ram motion
Read hydraulic_pressure_sensor to confirm near-zero pressure reading
Read hydraulic_oil_level_sensor to assess the volume of fluid already lost
Walk to spill_kit_station and pick spill_absorbent_pads
Place spill_absorbent_pads around the oil pool perimeter to contain the spread
Notify maintenance_supervisor and plant_safety_officer with location and estimated fluid loss

sop_examples.title: Ram Overtravel Soft-Limit Warning
sop_examples.condition: The ram_position_sensor triggers a soft-limit caution at Y-axis depth 5 mm beyond the programmed stop, flagging incremental drift while allowing production to continue without a machine lockout.
steps: Read ram_position_sensor to record the actual Y-axis depth at the alarm event
Press alarm_acknowledge_button to clear the caution indicator without halting production
Wait 300 seconds then read ram_position_sensor again to determine whether drift is progressing
Notify process_engineer with the recorded depth deviation value and drift trend

sop_examples.title: Ram Hard-Limit Fault — Full Machine Lockout
sop_examples.condition: The ram_position_sensor exceeds the hard-limit threshold at Y-axis depth 10 mm beyond programmed stop, triggering an automatic full machine lockout that requires supervisor clearance before any reset can be attempted.
steps: Read ram_position_sensor to record the exact hard-limit breach depth
Press red_estop_button to confirm the machine is fully de-energized
Walk to press_brake_ram_area and read ram_position_sensor at the tooling contact point to assess tooling damage
Notify maintenance_supervisor and process_engineer immediately with breach depth reading
Wait for maintenance_supervisor verbal clearance then press control_panel_reset_button to attempt fault reset

sop_examples.title: Back Gauge X-Axis Position Deviation Alarm
sop_examples.condition: The back_gauge_position_sensor reads more than 0.5 mm offset from the programmed X-axis target during a production run, causing bent-part flange-length rejection.
steps: Read back_gauge_position_sensor to record the actual versus programmed X-axis position
Press alarm_acknowledge_button to pause the bend cycle
Walk to press_brake_back_gauge_area and read back_gauge_position_sensor at the physical finger reference surface
Press back_gauge_home_button to execute a full re-home sequence
Read back_gauge_position_sensor to confirm the finger returned to datum within 0.1 mm
Notify process_engineer with the recorded deviation value and whether re-home resolved it

sop_examples.title: Punch Tonnage Overload Fault
sop_examples.condition: The tonnage_monitor reads a peak bending force exceeding the machine-rated 200-tonne capacity during a stroke, triggering an overload fault and halting the ram.
steps: Read tonnage_monitor to record the exact peak overload force value
Press red_estop_button to prevent additional bend strokes
Pick punch_tool and place it on parts_inspection_table for visual damage assessment
Notify process_engineer and maintenance_supervisor with the recorded tonnage value and suspected cause

sop_examples.title: Hydraulic Oil Temperature High
sop_examples.condition: The hydraulic_oil_temp_sensor reads above 60 degrees C, indicating the cooling system cannot keep pace with the current production duty cycle.
steps: Read hydraulic_oil_temp_sensor to confirm above-60 degree C reading
Press hydraulic_pump_stop_button to remove load and allow oil to cool
Wait 300 seconds then read hydraulic_oil_temp_sensor again
Walk to press_brake_hydraulic_unit and read hydraulic_oil_level_sensor to rule out a low-fluid contribution to overheating
Notify maintenance_supervisor if temperature does not fall below 55 degrees C within 5 minutes

sop_examples.title: Scheduled Hydraulic Return-Line Filter Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The hydraulic_filter_differential_pressure_sensor reads above 6 bar, or the 500-hour maintenance interval has elapsed, requiring the return-line filter element to be replaced.
steps: Walk to press_brake_control_panel and press hydraulic_pump_stop_button
Walk to maintenance_supply_cabinet and pick replacement_hydraulic_filter
Pick used_hydraulic_filter and place it in oil_drain_pan
Press hydraulic_pump_start_button and read hydraulic_filter_differential_pressure_sensor to confirm differential is below 3 bar
Notify maintenance_supervisor that filter replacement is complete and log the service date

sop_examples.title: Hydraulic Oil Level Verification and Top-Off
sop_examples.condition: The daily startup checklist requires oil-level verification, or the hydraulic_oil_level_sensor triggers a low-level caution during operation.
steps: Read hydraulic_oil_level_sensor to record the current level reading
Walk to oil_storage_area and pick hydraulic_oil_drum
Place hydraulic_oil_drum beside the oil_fill_port at press_brake_hydraulic_unit
Press oil_fill_pump_start_button to transfer oil until hydraulic_oil_level_sensor reads within the normal band
Wait 30 seconds and read hydraulic_oil_level_sensor to confirm the level is correct

sop_examples.title: Ram Guide Column Scheduled Lubrication
sop_examples.condition: The 250-hour lubrication interval for ram guide columns has elapsed, or visible dry scoring appears on column surfaces during inspection.
steps: Walk to press_brake_control_panel and press hydraulic_pump_stop_button
Walk to maintenance_supply_cabinet and pick grease_gun
Place grease_gun at each ram_guide_column_zerk_fitting to inject the specified quantity of ram_guide_grease
Wait 10 seconds to allow grease to distribute into the guide surfaces
Notify maintenance_supervisor that ram guide lubrication is complete and log the service date

sop_examples.title: Back Gauge Linear Rail and Lead Screw Lubrication
sop_examples.condition: The 250-hour lubrication interval for back gauge rails has elapsed, or the back_gauge_position_sensor shows positioning repeatability scatter exceeding 0.1 mm indicating friction-induced stick-slip.
steps: Walk to press_brake_control_panel and press hydraulic_pump_stop_button
Walk to maintenance_supply_cabinet and pick back_gauge_lubricant_bottle
Place back_gauge_lubricant_bottle along back_gauge_linear_rail surface and lead_screw to apply lubricant evenly
Press back_gauge_home_button to cycle the finger back and forth and distribute lubricant
Notify maintenance_supervisor that back gauge rail lubrication is complete and log the service date

sop_examples.title: Punch and Die Tooling Dimensional Inspection
sop_examples.condition: Every 1000 bends, or when a first-off part fails the bend angle check, the punch tip radius and die shoulder radius must be measured and compared against the 0.3 mm maximum wear tolerance.
steps: Walk to press_brake_ram_area and pick punch_tool
Walk to parts_inspection_table and pick tooling_caliper
Place tooling_caliper against punch_tip then read tooling_caliper to record the tip radius
Pick die_tool from press_brake_ram_area and place die_tool on parts_inspection_table
Place tooling_caliper against die_shoulder then read tooling_caliper to record the shoulder radius
Notify process_engineer with both caliper readings if either dimension exceeds the 0.3 mm wear tolerance

sop_examples.title: Hydraulic Oil Cooler Filter Cleaning
sop_examples.condition: The 1000-hour maintenance interval has elapsed for the oil cooler filter, or the hydraulic_oil_temp_sensor trends above 55 degrees C despite a correct oil level and moderate duty cycle.
steps: Walk to press_brake_control_panel and press hydraulic_pump_stop_button
Wait 120 seconds for oil temperature to drop before handling cooler components
Walk to press_brake_hydraulic_unit and pick cooler_filter_element
Walk to maintenance_supply_cabinet and pick compressed_air_gun
Place compressed_air_gun against cooler_filter_element to blow accumulated debris free
Walk to press_brake_hydraulic_unit and place cleaned cooler_filter_element back in cooler_housing; notify maintenance_supervisor

sop_examples.title: Electrical Cabinet Cooling Filter Service
sop_examples.condition: The 500-hour interval for electrical cabinet filter replacement has elapsed, or the cabinet_temperature_sensor reads above 45 degrees C indicating restricted cooling airflow.
steps: Read cabinet_temperature_sensor to record the current cabinet air temperature
Walk to maintenance_supply_cabinet and pick replacement_cabinet_filter
Pick used_cabinet_filter and place it in waste_bin
Notify maintenance_supervisor that cabinet filter has been replaced and log the service date

sop_examples.title: Full Machine Lockout and Tagout Before Maintenance
sop_examples.condition: Any maintenance, tooling change, or repair requiring removal of guards or access to hydraulic, electrical, or mechanical hazard zones must be preceded by full LOTO with verification of de-energized state.
steps: Walk to press_brake_control_panel and press red_estop_button
Press hydraulic_pump_stop_button to de-energize the hydraulic system
Walk to main_disconnect_panel and press loto_isolation_switch to cut the main electrical supply
Walk to maintenance_supply_cabinet and pick loto_padlock and pick loto_tag
Place loto_padlock on main_disconnect_panel latch and place loto_tag on loto_padlock
Read estop_relay_status to confirm the machine is fully de-energized
Notify maintenance_supervisor that LOTO is applied and the machine is cleared for work

sop_examples.title: Hydraulic Oil Minor Spill Containment and Cleanup
sop_examples.condition: Hydraulic oil is observed pooling on the floor beneath the press brake from a fitting seep or hose drip, covering an area smaller than 1 square metre with no pressure collapse or ongoing spray.
steps: Walk to press_brake_control_panel and press hydraulic_pump_stop_button
Walk to spill_kit_station and pick spill_absorbent_pads
Place spill_absorbent_pads around the oil pool perimeter to contain the spread
Pick spill_containment_boom and place it at the floor_drain nearest to the oil pool to block entry
Walk to press_brake_hydraulic_unit and read hydraulic_oil_level_sensor to estimate volume lost
Notify plant_safety_officer and maintenance_supervisor with the spill location and estimated fluid volume

sop_examples.title: Emergency Stop Activation and Controlled Machine Recovery
sop_examples.condition: Any operator, safety device, or light curtain triggers an emergency stop, halting the ram mid-stroke or between cycles and placing the machine in a fault state that blocks all normal controls.
steps: Read ram_position_sensor to record the current Y-axis depth and confirm the ram is stationary
Read hydraulic_pressure_sensor to confirm system pressure has dissipated to below 10 bar
Notify maintenance_supervisor with the ram position reading and the stated reason for the e-stop
Wait for maintenance_supervisor verbal clearance before touching any reset controls
Press control_panel_reset_button to acknowledge and clear the e-stop fault
Press green_power_on_button to restore the machine to the ready state

sop_examples.title: Monthly Fire Extinguisher and Safety Device Inspection
sop_examples.condition: The monthly safety inspection schedule requires confirming the press brake area fire extinguisher is charged and unobstructed, and that the e-stop circuit tests healthy.
steps: Pick fire_extinguisher and read fire_extinguisher_pressure_gauge to confirm the needle is in the green zone
Read estop_relay_status to confirm the e-stop circuit shows continuity
Notify safety_officer that the monthly press brake safety check is complete

sop_examples.title: Daily Press Brake Startup Procedure
sop_examples.condition: Beginning of each production shift, or after any machine shutdown exceeding 2 hours, requires a full controlled startup sequence before releasing the machine for production.
steps: Walk to press_brake_control_panel and press green_power_on_button
Press hydraulic_pump_start_button and wait 60 seconds for the hydraulic system to pressurize
Read hydraulic_pressure_sensor to confirm the operating range is between 185 and 215 bar
Read hydraulic_oil_temp_sensor to confirm oil temperature is above 20 degrees C before production begins
Press back_gauge_home_button to reference the back gauge to machine datum
Read back_gauge_position_sensor to confirm home position is within 0.1 mm of datum
Notify process_engineer that the machine has passed startup checks and is ready for production

sop_examples.title: End-of-Shift Press Brake Shutdown Procedure
sop_examples.condition: End of production shift or planned downtime exceeding 2 hours requires the ram to be parked at top dead centre and the hydraulic system to be de-energized in a controlled sequence.
steps: Walk to press_brake_control_panel and press ram_jog_up_button to retract the ram fully to top dead centre
Read ram_position_sensor to confirm the ram has reached the top-dead-centre park position
Press hydraulic_pump_stop_button to de-energize the hydraulic pump
Wait 30 seconds then read hydraulic_pressure_sensor to confirm residual pressure is below 10 bar
Press red_estop_button to place the machine in the safe-off state
Notify maintenance_supervisor that the shutdown sequence is complete

sop_examples.title: First-Off and Periodic Bend Angle Quality Inspection
sop_examples.condition: The first part of each production run, and every 50th part thereafter, must be measured for bend angle accuracy within plus or minus 0.5 degrees of the nominal programmed angle.
steps: Walk to press_brake_ram_area and pick first_off_part
Walk to parts_inspection_table and pick angle_gauge
Place angle_gauge against the bent_flange of first_off_part then read angle_gauge to record the actual bend angle
Place first_off_part in approved_parts_bin if the angle is within plus or minus 0.5 degrees of nominal
Place first_off_part in reject_bin if the angle is outside tolerance
Notify process_engineer with the recorded angle value whenever a part is placed in reject_bin

sop_examples.title: Zone Temperature Below Profile Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: One or more zone thermocouples read 5–15°C below the configured reflow profile setpoint during an active production run.

sop_examples.title: Zone Temperature Sudden Collapse
sop_examples.condition: Any zone thermocouple drops more than 25°C within a 60-second window, indicating a probable heater element failure.

sop_examples.title: Zone Temperature Above Upper Ceiling Limit
sop_examples.condition: Any zone thermocouple exceeds the configured upper ceiling temperature limit, activating an over-temperature alarm.

sop_examples.title: Conveyor Speed Below Programmed Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: The conveyor belt speed sensor reads more than 10% below the programmed profile setpoint for a continuous period exceeding 30 seconds, while the belt remains in motion.

sop_examples.title: Conveyor Motion Complete Stop During Run
sop_examples.condition: The conveyor motion sensor reads zero belt movement while the oven is in active production mode with boards loaded.

sop_examples.title: PCB Jam at Oven Entry Zone
sop_examples.condition: The entry zone board-present sensor remains continuously blocked for more than 30 seconds during a production run.

sop_examples.title: PCB Jam at Oven Exit or Cooling Zone
sop_examples.condition: The exit or cooling zone board-present sensor remains continuously blocked for more than 30 seconds while boards are in process.

sop_examples.title: Exhaust Airflow Below Advisory Warning Threshold
sop_examples.condition: The exhaust duct airflow sensor drops below the minimum advisory warning threshold, triggering a non-critical alarm on the control panel while oven remains operational.

sop_examples.title: Exhaust Airflow Critical Failure Emergency
sop_examples.condition: The exhaust duct airflow sensor reads near-zero, indicating complete fan failure or fully blocked ductwork, creating an immediate fume accumulation hazard requiring immediate shutdown.

sop_examples.title: Nitrogen Supply Pressure Below Minimum Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: The nitrogen supply pressure sensor reads below the minimum setpoint required to maintain an inert atmosphere in the reflow tunnel.

sop_examples.title: Cooling Zone Exceeds Maximum Exit Temperature
sop_examples.condition: The cooling zone thermocouple reads above the maximum permissible board exit temperature limit, risking thermal damage to assembled components.

sop_examples.title: Heater Zone Electrical or Ground Fault Alarm
sop_examples.condition: A heater zone SCR driver or ground fault alarm activates on the control panel display during oven operation.

sop_examples.title: Scheduled Conveyor Chain Lubrication
sop_examples.condition: The preventive maintenance calendar indicates the scheduled conveyor chain lubrication interval has elapsed.

sop_examples.title: Exhaust Flux Filter Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The exhaust filter differential pressure gauge reaches the change-required limit or the scheduled replacement interval elapses on the maintenance calendar.

sop_examples.title: Zone Thermocouple Calibration Verification
sop_examples.condition: The periodic calibration schedule is due or a zone thermocouple drift exceeding ±2°C relative to the reference standard is detected.

sop_examples.title: Scheduled Conveyor Belt Tension and Wear Inspection
sop_examples.condition: The preventive maintenance calendar indicates the conveyor belt tension and wear inspection interval has been reached.

sop_examples.title: Nitrogen Flow Meter Sensor Scheduled Cleaning
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled nitrogen flow meter sensor cleaning interval has elapsed per the preventive maintenance calendar.

sop_examples.title: Cooling Zone Fan Blade Cleaning
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled cooling zone fan blade cleaning interval has elapsed or visual inspection reveals significant flux residue accumulation on fan blades.

sop_examples.title: Reflow Oven Lockout Tagout Procedure
sop_examples.condition: A maintenance task requiring physical access inside the reflow oven enclosure is scheduled to begin.

sop_examples.title: Minor Flux Residue Spill Response
sop_examples.condition: A flux residue spill of less than one liter is observed on the oven exterior surface or immediately adjacent floor area.

sop_examples.title: Major Flux Container Rupture and Spill Response
sop_examples.condition: A flux container failure or rupture releases more than five liters of flux in or around the oven area, creating an immediate chemical exposure hazard.

sop_examples.title: Reflow Oven Cold Start Startup Procedure
sop_examples.condition: The reflow oven is in a fully de-energized and cold state and requires startup for production.

sop_examples.title: Wire Feeder Jam Response
sop_examples.condition: Wire feeder has stopped advancing wire entirely during an active weld cycle and the wire-jam fault indicator is illuminated on the feeder panel.

sop_examples.title: Wire Feed Rate Below Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: Wire feed rate sensor reads below the minimum operating setpoint of 5.0 m/min while the arc remains active and wire continues to move.

sop_examples.title: Wire Feed Rate Exceeds Maximum Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: Wire feed rate sensor exceeds the maximum operating setpoint of 12.0 m/min, creating risk of wire birdnesting inside the feeder housing.

sop_examples.title: Weld Current Below Programmed Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: Weld current sensor reads more than 15 percent below the programmed amperage setpoint during an active weld pass without triggering a hard fault alarm.

sop_examples.title: Weld Current Overcurrent Alarm
sop_examples.condition: Weld current sensor reads more than 20 percent above the programmed amperage setpoint and the controller activates an overcurrent alarm that halts the weld cycle.

sop_examples.title: Shielding Gas Low Pressure Warning
sop_examples.condition: Shielding gas supply pressure sensor reads below the low-pressure warning threshold of 30 psi but remains above the critical shutoff threshold of 10 psi, and welding continues.

sop_examples.title: Sudden Total Shielding Gas Pressure Loss
sop_examples.condition: Shielding gas pressure drops from normal operating level to zero within 10 seconds, indicating a line rupture, failed regulator, or instantaneous cylinder depletion.

sop_examples.title: Minor Torch Coolant Seepage
sop_examples.condition: Coolant level sensor shows a gradual decline and inspection reveals seepage or isolated drips at torch coolant hose fittings with no pooling on the floor.

sop_examples.title: Major Coolant Line Rupture
sop_examples.condition: Coolant flow sensor drops to zero and coolant is visibly pooling on the floor beneath the robot arm or torch body, indicating a hose burst or catastrophic fitting failure.

sop_examples.title: Weld Controller Communication Fault
sop_examples.condition: Weld controller display shows a communication fault code indicating loss of Ethernet link to the robot controller, halting weld cycle initiation.

sop_examples.title: Fixture Clamp Position Sensor Fault
sop_examples.condition: Fixture clamp position sensor reports a clamp-not-confirmed state that prevents weld cycle initiation even though the clamp appears physically closed.

sop_examples.title: Robot Axis Motor Overtemperature Alarm
sop_examples.condition: Robot axis motor temperature sensor exceeds 85 degrees C and the controller activates a thermal protection alarm that stops all robot motion.

sop_examples.title: Scheduled Contact Tip Replacement
sop_examples.condition: Weld controller arc-on timer has reached the 500-minute contact-tip replacement interval and the scheduled maintenance flag is active on the controller display.

sop_examples.title: Wire Conduit Liner Replacement
sop_examples.condition: Wire liner inspection interval has elapsed or the wire-feed resistance sensor has risen above the liner-wear threshold, indicating conduit degradation.

sop_examples.title: Wire Spool Empty Changeover
sop_examples.condition: Wire spool weight sensor reads below the minimum threshold, indicating the spool is nearly depleted and must be replaced before the next weld cycle.

sop_examples.title: Monthly Weld Parameter Calibration
sop_examples.condition: Monthly weld parameter calibration flag has been activated on the weld controller display, indicating scheduled verification of current and voltage output accuracy is due.

sop_examples.title: Fixture Slide and Clamp Lubrication
sop_examples.condition: Fixture cycle counter has reached the 250-cycle lubrication interval as tracked by the cell controller, requiring grease application to slide rails and clamp pivot points.

sop_examples.title: Weld Spatter Removal and Nozzle Cleaning
sop_examples.condition: Weld spatter buildup counter has reached the cleaning threshold or the nozzle blockage sensor has activated, indicating the torch nozzle requires cleaning and anti-spatter treatment.

sop_examples.title: Lockout-Tagout for Cell Entry
sop_examples.condition: Maintenance personnel must physically enter the robotic weld cell boundary for repair, inspection, or tooling change, requiring full energy isolation before entry.

sop_examples.title: Weld Flash Fire Response
sop_examples.condition: Smoke or flame is detected inside the weld cell by the fire detection sensor or is visually confirmed by an operator, indicating ignition from weld spatter or arc flash.

sop_examples.title: Weld Cell Startup Sequence
sop_examples.condition: The robotic weld cell has been powered down and must be brought to a production-ready state at the start of a shift or after a planned outage.

sop_examples.title: Weld Cell Shutdown Sequence
sop_examples.condition: Production shift has ended or an extended planned stop is scheduled and the robotic weld cell must be safely de-energized and secured.

sop_examples.title: Zone Motor Overcurrent Fault Response
sop_examples.condition: A zone motor current sensor reads above the rated amperage threshold for more than 3 seconds, triggering a drive fault alarm on the control panel.
steps: Walk to zone_1_control_panel to reach the faulted drive.
Read zone_1_current_sensor to confirm the overcurrent fault code is active and record the displayed amperage.
Press zone_1_stop_button to halt the zone motor immediately.
Wait 60 seconds for the motor winding to cool and the drive fault register to reset.
Read zone_1_current_sensor again to verify amperage has returned to within the rated normal range.
Notify maintenance_supervisor of the overcurrent event, zone shutdown, and sensor reading.
Press zone_1_start_button to restart the zone only after maintenance_supervisor grants clearance.

sop_examples.title: Photo-Eye Blocked Alarm With No Product Present
sop_examples.condition: A zone photo-eye sensor reports a sustained beam interruption while no product is scheduled or present in that zone, indicating a foreign object, debris, or sensor contamination rather than a legitimate detection.
steps: Walk to photo_eye_zone_2_location to inspect the sensor and its field of view.
Read photo_eye_zone_2_sensor to confirm the blocked status is active with no product in the zone.
Notify line_supervisor of the spurious blockage alarm and zone location.
Place lens_cleaning_cloth on photo_eye_zone_2_lens to wipe debris from both emitter and receiver faces.
Wait 10 seconds for the sensor electronics to re-initialize after cleaning.
Read photo_eye_zone_2_sensor to confirm the beam is restored and the alarm has cleared.

sop_examples.title: Product Jam Detected in Conveyor Zone
sop_examples.condition: A product carrier physically stalls in a conveyor zone, causing the zone motor to continue running against a stationary load for more than 5 seconds with zero downstream movement registered by the exit sensor.
steps: Walk to jam_location_zone_3 to reach the stalled carrier.
Read zone_3_jam_sensor to confirm product movement has stopped and the motor is still energized.
Press zone_3_stop_button to shut down the zone motor and prevent further drive strain.
Pick jammed_carrier from conveyor_rollers to free the obstruction.
Place jammed_carrier on staging_table adjacent to the conveyor for damage inspection.
Notify quality_technician to inspect the carrier and its product for damage before recirculation.
Press zone_3_start_button to resume zone operation after the jam site is confirmed clear.

sop_examples.title: Product Gap Below Minimum Separation Threshold
sop_examples.condition: The inter-zone gap sensor reads a carrier-to-carrier spacing less than the 150 mm minimum safety margin, meaning products are running dangerously close together and risk contact-induced shifting or damage.
steps: Walk to gap_sensor_zone_2_location to access the speed control for the affected zone.
Read gap_sensor_zone_2 to confirm the current spacing reading is below the 150 mm minimum threshold.
Press zone_2_speed_decrease_button to reduce zone 2 conveyor speed by one programmed increment.
Wait 20 seconds for the carrier spacing to stabilize at the new speed.
Read gap_sensor_zone_2 to verify the gap has increased to within the acceptable 150–600 mm range.
Notify line_supervisor if the gap reading remains below threshold after two successive speed adjustments.

sop_examples.title: Product Gap Above Maximum Separation Threshold
sop_examples.condition: The inter-zone gap sensor reads a carrier-to-carrier spacing greater than the 600 mm target ceiling, indicating that products are spaced too far apart and the line throughput rate has fallen below the production target.
steps: Walk to gap_sensor_zone_2_location to access the speed control for the affected zone.
Read gap_sensor_zone_2 to confirm the current spacing reading exceeds the 600 mm maximum threshold.
Press zone_2_speed_increase_button to raise zone 2 conveyor speed by one programmed increment.
Wait 20 seconds for the carrier spacing to stabilize at the new speed.
Read gap_sensor_zone_2 to verify the gap has decreased to within the acceptable 150–600 mm range.
Notify line_supervisor if the gap remains above threshold after two successive speed adjustments.

sop_examples.title: Zone Accumulation Count Exceeds Maximum Buffer Limit
sop_examples.condition: The accumulation counter for a downstream buffer zone exceeds the configured maximum buffer count, meaning the zone is full and continued upstream feeding will cause a backpressure jam.
steps: Walk to accumulation_zone_4_control_panel to view the current buffer count.
Read accumulation_counter_zone_4 to confirm the count exceeds the maximum configured buffer limit.
Press zone_3_feed_stop_button to halt upstream product feeding into the full zone.
Wait 30 seconds for zone 4 to discharge accumulated product to the downstream process.
Read accumulation_counter_zone_4 to verify the count has dropped below the high-buffer threshold.
Press zone_3_feed_start_button to resume upstream feeding now that buffer space is available.
Notify production_supervisor if the accumulation count reaches maximum more than twice within a single hour.

sop_examples.title: Zone Accumulation Count Below Minimum Buffer Level
sop_examples.condition: The accumulation counter for a buffer zone falls below the minimum configured threshold, signaling that the downstream workstation or robot cell is at imminent risk of starving for product.
steps: Walk to accumulation_zone_4_control_panel to view the current buffer count.
Read accumulation_counter_zone_4 to confirm the count is below the minimum buffer threshold.
Press zone_3_feed_boost_button to temporarily increase the upstream feed rate and replenish the buffer.
Wait 45 seconds for the buffer zone to accumulate additional product.
Read accumulation_counter_zone_4 to confirm the count has risen above the minimum threshold.
Notify production_supervisor if the buffer cannot recover to the minimum level within two feed cycles.

sop_examples.title: Zone Motor Running Slow – Speed Below Programmed Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: The zone speed encoder reports a conveyor belt speed that is 15% or more below the programmed setpoint for longer than 10 seconds, while the zone motor remains energized and continues to run.
steps: Walk to zone_2_drive_panel to access speed and current readouts.
Read zone_2_speed_encoder to confirm the measured speed is below the setpoint by 15% or more.
Read zone_2_current_sensor to check whether elevated motor current indicates an increased mechanical load.
Notify maintenance_technician of the under-speed condition, providing both the speed reading and current draw.
Press zone_2_stop_button to shut down the zone in a controlled manner.
Wait 30 seconds for the motor to fully decelerate and the drive to clear.
Press zone_2_start_button to restart the zone and verify that speed recovers to setpoint.

sop_examples.title: Zone Motor Running Fast – Speed Exceeds Programmed Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: The zone speed encoder reports a conveyor belt speed that is 10% or more above the programmed setpoint, indicating a drive control fault, encoder miscalibration, or runaway condition.
steps: Walk to zone_2_drive_panel to access drive readouts.
Read zone_2_speed_encoder to confirm the measured speed exceeds the setpoint by 10% or more.
Press zone_2_stop_button immediately to halt the overspeed zone and prevent product damage.
Notify maintenance_technician of the overspeed fault, providing the encoder reading and time of occurrence.
Wait 60 seconds for the drive electronics to fully depower and discharge.
Read zone_2_speed_encoder to verify the output reads zero before any restart attempt.
Notify production_supervisor before attempting to resume zone operation.

sop_examples.title: Zone Stopped Unexpectedly Without E-Stop or Fault Code
