sop_examples.condition: A conveyor zone motor ceases operation and the speed encoder reads zero, but no emergency stop button is depressed, no drive fault code is displayed, and no scheduled shutdown was initiated.
steps: Walk to zone_1_drive_panel to inspect the drive status with no E-stop active.
Read zone_1_speed_encoder to confirm zero speed and the absence of any active E-stop signal.
Read zone_1_current_sensor to check for zero-current indicating an open circuit or failed contactor.
Notify maintenance_technician of the unexplained stoppage and provide both sensor readings.
Press zone_1_stop_button to place the zone in a confirmed controlled-stop state before investigation.
Wait 15 seconds to allow any transient fault to resolve.
Press zone_1_start_button to attempt a controlled restart and observe whether the zone responds.

sop_examples.title: Photo-Eye Sensor Intermittent Misread – Calibration Drift
sop_examples.condition: A zone photo-eye sensor produces intermittent false-clear or false-blocked outputs during normal product flow without sustaining a blocked alarm, suggesting lens contamination or gradual alignment drift rather than a hard fault.
steps: Walk to photo_eye_zone_1_location to access the sensor during live production.
Read photo_eye_zone_1_sensor to log the current output signal level during a product pass.
Place lens_cleaning_cloth on photo_eye_zone_1_lens to clean both the emitter and receiver faces of residue and film.
Wait 15 seconds for the sensor electronics to stabilize after cleaning.
Read photo_eye_zone_1_sensor to verify the output signal is consistent and stable during subsequent product passes.
Notify maintenance_technician if intermittent misreads persist after cleaning, as alignment realignment may be required.

sop_examples.title: Emergency Stop Button Activation Response
sop_examples.condition: An emergency stop button on the conveyor line has been pressed, halting all powered roller zones simultaneously and requiring a safe area inspection before the line can be restored.
steps: Walk to estop_north_button_location to identify which E-stop station is engaged.
Read estop_status_sensor to confirm which zone or station triggered the stop and verify all zones have ceased motion.
Notify line_supervisor and safety_officer of the E-stop activation, station location, and current line status.
Walk to hazard_location adjacent to the engaged E-stop to visually verify the area is clear of personnel and obstructions.
Read zone_1_speed_encoder to confirm all conveyor motion has fully ceased before reset.
Press estop_north_reset_button to release the E-stop latch only after the area is confirmed safe by safety_officer.
Press conveyor_master_start_button to restore conveyor operation in sequence.

sop_examples.title: Scheduled Drive Chain Lubrication
sop_examples.condition: The planned maintenance interval for drive chain lubrication has been reached per the PM schedule (every 500 operating hours) or the chain produces audible dry running noise before the interval.
steps: Walk to maintenance_station to retrieve lubrication supplies.
Walk to zone_1_drive_chain_access_panel to reach the drive chain.
Place chain_lube_cartridge nozzle onto zone_1_drive_chain to apply lubricant along the full chain length.
Wait 5 seconds for the lubricant to distribute across the chain links.
Read chain_tension_indicator_zone_1 to confirm the chain tension reading is within the specified range.
Notify maintenance_supervisor that the PM lubrication task is complete and ready to log.

sop_examples.title: Worn Conveyor Roller Bearing Replacement
sop_examples.condition: A conveyor roller bearing emits sustained squealing or the vibration sensor on that roller reads above the allowable threshold, indicating bearing wear that requires immediate replacement to prevent roller seizure.
steps: Walk to tool_crib to retrieve bearing replacement tooling.
Walk to faulty_roller_location on the conveyor frame.
Pick worn_bearing from roller_shaft to remove the failed bearing.
Place replacement_bearing onto roller_shaft to install the new bearing.
Read vibration_sensor_roller to confirm the vibration level has returned to within the normal operating range.
Notify maintenance_supervisor that the bearing replacement is complete and record the roller position.

sop_examples.title: Routine Photo-Eye Lens Cleaning – Preventive Maintenance
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled preventive maintenance interval for photo-eye lens cleaning has been reached (every 250 operating hours) to maintain reliable beam strength and detection accuracy.
steps: Walk to maintenance_station to retrieve scheduled cleaning supplies.
Walk to photo_eye_zone_3_location to access the scheduled sensor.
Place lens_cleaning_cloth on photo_eye_zone_3_emitter_lens to clean the emitter face.
Place lens_cleaning_cloth on photo_eye_zone_3_receiver_lens to clean the receiver face.
Wait 10 seconds for the sensor to stabilize after cleaning.
Read photo_eye_zone_3_sensor to confirm beam signal strength is within the calibration acceptance range.

sop_examples.title: Zone Speed Encoder Calibration Verification
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled calibration verification for the zone speed encoder is due per the PM calendar, or post-maintenance verification is required after a drive belt or motor component has been replaced.
steps: Walk to zone_2_drive_panel to access the speed encoder coupling.
Place encoder_calibration_tool on zone_2_speed_encoder coupling to establish the reference measurement.
Read zone_2_speed_encoder to record the current output at the known reference speed.
Wait 30 seconds for a stable, settled reading.
Read zone_2_speed_encoder a second time to compare against the calibration standard tolerance.
Notify maintenance_supervisor of the calibration result and whether adjustment or replacement is needed.

sop_examples.title: Zone Motor Cooling Filter Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The zone motor cooling filter differential pressure sensor reads above the high-pressure warning threshold or the replacement interval of 1000 operating hours has been reached, indicating the filter is clogged and restricting motor cooling airflow.
steps: Walk to zone_motor_filter_access_zone_1 to reach the motor cooling filter housing.
Read filter_pressure_sensor_zone_1 to confirm the differential pressure exceeds the replacement threshold.
Press zone_1_stop_button to shut down the zone motor before opening the filter housing.
Pick dirty_filter_zone_1 from motor_filter_housing to remove the clogged filter.
Place dirty_filter_zone_1 in waste_container for proper disposal.
Place replacement_filter_zone_1 into motor_filter_housing and notify maintenance_supervisor that the replacement is complete.

sop_examples.title: Conveyor Lockout/Tagout Before Maintenance Work
sop_examples.condition: Maintenance work requiring physical access to any powered roller conveyor component has been authorized and all conveyor energy sources must be isolated before any personnel enter the equipment envelope.
steps: Walk to conveyor_master_control_panel to initiate the isolation sequence.
Press conveyor_master_stop_button to halt all zones and confirm the line is at rest.
Pick lockout_padlock from lockout_kit at safety_station.
Place lockout_padlock on conveyor_master_disconnect_switch to lock the disconnect in the OFF position.
Wait 30 seconds for all stored mechanical and electrical energy to dissipate.
Read estop_status_sensor to confirm a zero-energy state across all zones.
Notify maintenance_supervisor and safety_officer that lockout is fully established and maintenance work may begin.

sop_examples.title: Oil or Grease Spill Response Near Conveyor
sop_examples.condition: Lubricant or gear oil is detected on or adjacent to the conveyor structure, creating a slip hazard for floor personnel and a contamination risk for product carriers passing through the affected zone.
steps: Walk to oil_spill_location identified by the reporting operator.
Read spill_detection_sensor to confirm the spill extent and verify no product carriers are entering the contaminated area.
Notify safety_officer and line_supervisor of the spill location and estimated size immediately.
Place oil_absorbent_pad over the spill area to begin absorbing the lubricant.
Wait 120 seconds for full absorption, then pick used_absorbent_pad from the spill area.
Place used_absorbent_pad in hazmat_waste_bin and notify safety_officer that the area is clear and safe to re-enter.

sop_examples.title: Beginning-of-Shift Conveyor System Startup
sop_examples.condition: The conveyor system is offline at the start of a production shift and must be energized, inspected, and ramped to operating speed before the first product can be loaded onto the line.
steps: Walk to conveyor_master_control_panel to begin the startup sequence.
Read estop_status_sensor to confirm no emergency stop buttons are engaged before energizing.
Press conveyor_master_start_button to energize all zones in the programmed sequential startup order.
Wait 45 seconds for all zone motors to reach operating speed.
Read zone_1_speed_encoder to verify the infeed zone is running at the target speed.
Read zone_3_speed_encoder to verify the mid-line zone is running at the target speed.
Notify production_supervisor that the conveyor system is operational and ready for production loading.

sop_examples.title: End-of-Shift Conveyor System Shutdown
sop_examples.condition: The production shift has ended and the powered roller conveyor must be shut down in a controlled downstream-to-upstream sequence after all product carriers have been cleared from every zone.
steps: Walk to accumulation_zone_4_control_panel to verify all zones are clear before shutdown.
Read accumulation_counter_zone_4 to confirm the buffer zone shows zero carriers and all zones are empty.
Walk to conveyor_master_control_panel to initiate the shutdown sequence.
Press zone_3_stop_button to halt the exit zone first.
Press zone_1_stop_button to halt the infeed zone and complete the upstream shutdown.
Wait 30 seconds for all rollers to decelerate fully to zero.
Notify production_supervisor that the conveyor shutdown sequence is complete and the line is safe.

sop_examples.title: Scheduled Conveyor Inspection Walkthrough
sop_examples.condition: A scheduled daily or weekly inspection is due to assess roller, sensor, drive chain, and structural integrity across all conveyor zones before or during production.
steps: Walk to zone_1_inspection_point at the infeed end of the conveyor line.
Read vibration_sensor_roller to check roller bearing vibration levels against the baseline specification.
Walk to zone_3_inspection_point at the mid-line inspection station.
Read photo_eye_zone_3_sensor to verify beam alignment and signal strength are within calibration limits.
Read chain_tension_indicator_zone_1 to confirm drive chain tension is within the specified range.
Notify maintenance_supervisor of any sensor readings or observations that fall outside the acceptable range.
Walk to conveyor_master_control_panel and notify production_supervisor that the inspection walkthrough is complete.

sop_examples.title: Torque Reading Below Minimum Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: During a fastening cycle the torque sensor reads a value below the programmed minimum threshold, indicating a potential undertorqued fastener without triggering an automatic cell stop.

sop_examples.title: Torque Reading Above Maximum Ceiling
sop_examples.condition: During a fastening cycle the torque sensor reads a value exceeding the programmed upper ceiling, indicating overtorque risk, cross-threading, or interference with the joint.

sop_examples.title: Abrupt Torque Signal Collapse During Active Fastening
sop_examples.condition: The torque signal rises normally during the fastening stroke then drops abruptly to near-zero mid-cycle, indicating sudden bit fracture or catastrophic thread strip-out rather than a gradual under- or over-reading.

sop_examples.title: Screw Feeder Bowl Mechanical Jam
sop_examples.condition: The vibratory bowl feeder halts mid-operation with its drive motor still energized, and the screw-at-escapement sensor shows no part present for more than ten consecutive seconds, indicating a physical obstruction in the feed track.

sop_examples.title: Screw Feeder Hopper Supply Exhausted
sop_examples.condition: The hopper level sensor triggers an empty alarm while the vibratory bowl continues to operate normally with no physical jam, indicating the bulk fastener supply has been fully depleted.

sop_examples.title: Screwdriver Bit Approaching End-of-Life Threshold
sop_examples.condition: The bit life counter reaches 80 percent of the programmed service interval, generating a scheduled advisory warning without stopping production or triggering any cycle fault.

sop_examples.title: Screwdriver Bit Fracture Emergency
sop_examples.condition: The bit breakage sensor detects a fractured or missing bit during an active cycle, triggering an immediate critical fault that halts the spindle and requires fragment recovery before any restart.

sop_examples.title: Spindle Motor Overtemperature Advisory Warning
sop_examples.condition: The spindle drive motor temperature sensor reads above the 80 degrees Celsius advisory threshold but below the 100 degrees Celsius automatic shutdown limit, generating a caution alarm while production continues.

sop_examples.title: Spindle Motor Thermal Shutdown Trip
sop_examples.condition: The spindle drive motor temperature sensor reaches or exceeds the 100 degrees Celsius emergency threshold, triggering an automatic thermal shutdown that locks the drive and prevents any restart attempt.

sop_examples.title: Screw Presence Sensor No-Detect Fault at Driver Tip
sop_examples.condition: The screw presence sensor at the driver nose fails to confirm a fastener is loaded at the tip before cycle start, aborting the cycle due to a feed miss or sensor occlusion rather than any torque or depth deviation.

sop_examples.title: Fastener Driven Beyond Maximum Seating Depth
sop_examples.condition: The seating depth sensor reads a value exceeding the programmed maximum allowable depth, indicating the fastener has been driven past the specified flush limit into the workpiece.

sop_examples.title: Fastener Not Driven to Minimum Seating Depth
sop_examples.condition: The seating depth sensor reads a value below the programmed minimum allowable depth, indicating the fastener head remains proud of the workpiece surface and has not reached the specified flush depth.

sop_examples.title: Electrical Control Cabinet Overtemperature Fault
sop_examples.condition: The control cabinet internal temperature sensor exceeds 55 degrees Celsius, triggering a thermal fault alarm that risks damage to drive electronics and control boards inside the enclosure.

sop_examples.title: Spindle Variable-Frequency Drive Internal E-Fault
sop_examples.condition: The spindle variable-frequency drive displays an E-fault error code on its local panel, indicating an internal drive protection trip due to overcurrent, undervoltage, or phase imbalance that is distinct from a motor thermal or torque alarm.

sop_examples.title: Mandatory Screwdriver Bit Replacement at Service Limit
sop_examples.condition: The bit life counter reaches 100 percent of the programmed service interval, locking out further production cycles until the worn bit is physically removed and a new bit is installed.

sop_examples.title: Vibratory Bowl Feeder Scheduled Cleaning
sop_examples.condition: The weekly cleaning interval has elapsed or the feeder bowl shows visible accumulation of metal chips, coolant mist residue, or debris that disrupts screw orientation without causing a hard jam.

sop_examples.title: Scheduled Torque Tool Output Calibration Verification
sop_examples.condition: The calibration interval counter has elapsed, requiring a verification run of torque output against a calibrated reference transducer before production continues.

sop_examples.title: Controller Cabinet Air Intake Filter Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The differential pressure switch across the cabinet intake filter triggers an airflow restriction alarm, indicating the filter is loaded to the point of reducing cabinet cooling below the minimum airflow threshold.

sop_examples.title: Linear Slide Rail Scheduled Lubrication
sop_examples.condition: The weekly lubrication interval has elapsed or the slide axis position error sensor reports a deviation exceeding 0.5 mm, indicating dry rail friction is degrading positioning accuracy.

sop_examples.title: Cell Lockout-Tagout for Maintenance Entry
sop_examples.condition: Any maintenance activity requires personnel to enter the screwdriving cell guarded area or contact energized or moving components, necessitating full energy isolation before work begins.

sop_examples.title: Emergency Stop Activation Response and Reset
sop_examples.condition: An emergency stop button has been activated on the screwdriving cell, halting all motion; the triggering hazard must be formally assessed and cleared before the cell can be returned to production.

sop_examples.title: Daily Production Shift Startup Sequence
sop_examples.condition: At the beginning of each production shift the screwdriving cell has been powered down and requires a systematic bring-up and pre-production verification before the first fastening cycle.

sop_examples.title: Film Tension Below Minimum Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: The film_tension_sensor reads below 120 N while the turntable is actively rotating, indicating the stretch film is applying insufficient holding force to the pallet load.
steps: Read film_tension_sensor to confirm the reading is below 120 N
Press cycle_stop_button to halt the active wrap cycle
Read pre_stretch_ratio_sensor to check the current pre-stretch percentage
Notify maintenance_tech with the current film_tension_sensor and pre_stretch_ratio_sensor readings
Wait 300 seconds for maintenance_tech to arrive and adjust the pre-stretch roller gap
Press green_start_button only after maintenance_tech confirms tension is within the 120-280 N specification

sop_examples.title: Film Tension Above Maximum Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: The film_tension_sensor reads above 280 N during active wrapping, indicating the film is over-stretched and at immediate risk of tearing.
steps: Press cycle_stop_button immediately to prevent film tear
Read film_tension_sensor to log the peak over-tension value
Read pre_stretch_ratio_sensor to determine if the roller ratio is set too high
Notify maintenance_tech with both sensor readings and the current pallet ID
Wait 180 seconds for maintenance_tech to reduce the pre-stretch roller gap
Press yellow_reset_button to clear the tension fault alarm before restarting

sop_examples.title: Film Break During Active Wrap Cycle
sop_examples.condition: The film_break_detector activates mid-cycle indicating the stretch film has physically ruptured and is no longer attached to the pallet load.
steps: Press cycle_stop_button to stop turntable rotation immediately
Pick film_tail_end from the pallet load surface at the break point
Press film_carriage_down_button to lower the carriage to the base position
Notify shift_supervisor that the wrap cycle must be restarted from the beginning

sop_examples.title: Film Roll Depleted Mid-Cycle
sop_examples.condition: The film_roll_sensor detects that the active film roll diameter has dropped below the minimum threshold of 50 mm, signaling the roll is exhausted.
steps: Press cycle_stop_button to pause the wrap cycle
Read film_roll_sensor to confirm roll diameter is below 50 mm
Pick film_roll_depleted from the film carriage mandrel
Walk to film_storage_rack and pick film_roll_new
Place film_roll_new onto the film carriage mandrel and thread the film tail through the pre-stretch rollers

sop_examples.title: Turntable Speed Below Target RPM
sop_examples.condition: The turntable_speed_sensor reads below 4 RPM for more than 10 consecutive seconds while a wrap cycle is active, indicating a partial drive loss but with the turntable still rotating.
steps: Read turntable_speed_sensor to confirm the sustained under-speed condition
Press cycle_stop_button to prevent an under-wrapped pallet from leaving the station
Read motor_temp_sensor to check for drive motor thermal stress
Notify maintenance_tech with the turntable_speed_sensor and motor_temp_sensor readings
Wait 240 seconds for maintenance_tech to inspect the turntable drive belt and VFD settings

sop_examples.title: Turntable Fully Stopped During Active Cycle
sop_examples.condition: The turntable_speed_sensor reads exactly zero RPM while the PLC reports the wrap cycle is in an active running state and no operator stop command has been issued.
steps: Read turntable_speed_sensor to confirm the zero-speed fault reading
Press red_estop_button to place the machine in a safe state
Read turntable_load_sensor to determine whether an overweight pallet caused the stall
Notify maintenance_tech with turntable_speed_sensor and turntable_load_sensor values and the stall timestamp
Wait 600 seconds for maintenance_tech to clear the drive fault before releasing the e-stop

sop_examples.title: Turntable Drive Motor Overload Trip
sop_examples.condition: The turntable_load_sensor triggers an overcurrent trip on the drive motor controller, shutting down turntable motion entirely and illuminating the motor overload fault indicator on the main panel.
steps: Read turntable_load_sensor to record the overcurrent value at the moment of trip
Press red_estop_button to lock out further drive restart attempts
Notify maintenance_tech and shift_supervisor that a motor overload trip has occurred
Wait 900 seconds for the overload relay to thermally reset and for maintenance_tech to inspect the motor
Press yellow_reset_button only after maintenance_tech clears the motor overload relay and authorizes restart

sop_examples.title: Film Carriage Vertical Travel Jam
sop_examples.condition: The film_carriage_position_sensor reports that the carriage has not moved more than 2 mm in 8 seconds despite an active vertical travel command from the PLC.
steps: Read film_carriage_position_sensor to record the stuck carriage height
Press cycle_stop_button to halt all carriage and turntable motion
Press film_carriage_up_button and hold for 3 seconds to attempt to free minor mechanical binding
Read film_carriage_position_sensor again to determine whether the carriage has moved
Notify maintenance_tech if the carriage position reading has not changed after the manual bump attempt

sop_examples.title: Cutter Blade Failed to Actuate at Cycle End
sop_examples.condition: The cutter_position_sensor does not confirm a cut-complete signal within 5 seconds of the cycle-end command being issued by the PLC, indicating the cutter mechanism did not fire.
steps: Read cutter_position_sensor to confirm the cutter did not reach its full-cut position
Press cutter_manual_actuate_button once to attempt a manual cut
Read cutter_position_sensor to verify whether the manual actuation succeeded
Pick film_tail_end manually from the pallet surface if the cutter still did not fire
Notify maintenance_tech to inspect the cutter solenoid and blade assembly

sop_examples.title: Pallet Load Height Exceeds Maximum Sensor Limit
sop_examples.condition: The load_height_sensor detects an inbound pallet load taller than 2200 mm, which exceeds the wrapper safe operating height and must be rejected before any wrapping begins.
steps: Read load_height_sensor to confirm the over-height measurement
Press cycle_stop_button to prevent the wrap cycle from initiating
Notify shift_supervisor with the load_height_sensor reading and the pallet ID
Wait 120 seconds for shift_supervisor to arrange pallet re-staging or load reduction
Read load_height_sensor after correction to confirm the load is within the 2200 mm limit before pressing green_start_button

sop_examples.title: Pallet Load Below Minimum Height Threshold
sop_examples.condition: The load_height_sensor reads below 300 mm, indicating the pallet load is too short for the film carriage to engage properly and the wrapping pattern will miss the load entirely.
steps: Read load_height_sensor to confirm the under-height measurement
Press cycle_stop_button to prevent a wasteful and ineffective wrap cycle
Notify quality_inspector with the load_height_sensor reading and the pallet ID
Wait 180 seconds for quality_inspector to assess whether additional product can be staged onto the pallet
Read load_height_sensor after correction to verify the load exceeds the 300 mm minimum before restarting

sop_examples.title: Safety Photoeye Sensor Fault or Blocked Beam
sop_examples.condition: The photoeye_sensor_A or photoeye_sensor_B reports a blocked or degraded beam signal while the wrapper turntable is idle, indicating either a safety zone intrusion or a dirty sensor lens.
steps: Read photoeye_sensor_A to identify whether the A-channel beam is faulted
Read photoeye_sensor_B to check whether the B-channel beam is also affected
Press cycle_stop_button to prevent any inadvertent cycle start while the safety zone status is uncertain
Place cleaning_cloth against each photoeye lens in turn and wipe to remove film dust and residue
Notify maintenance_tech if the fault persists after lens cleaning

sop_examples.title: Lockout Tagout Before Wrapper Maintenance
sop_examples.condition: Any planned maintenance task including blade replacement, carriage servicing, or belt inspection requires the stretch wrapper to be fully de-energized under lockout-tagout before work begins.
steps: Press red_estop_button to halt all machine motion
Press main_disconnect_switch to remove power from the stretch wrapper
Place loto_padlock onto the main_disconnect_switch hasp to lock it in the off position
Place safety_tag onto the loto_padlock to identify the authorized worker
Notify maintenance_tech that lockout is complete and maintenance work may begin

sop_examples.title: Film Carriage Vertical Mast Rail Lubrication
sop_examples.condition: The preventive maintenance schedule indicates the film carriage vertical mast rails are due for lubrication every 500 wrap cycles or weekly, whichever comes first.
steps: Press red_estop_button to secure the wrapper before lubrication work
Press film_carriage_up_button to raise the carriage to the top of the mast for full-rail access
Place lubricant_bottle applicator tip against each mast rail bearing channel in turn and apply two full strokes per rail
Press film_carriage_down_button to cycle the carriage fully down and verify smooth travel after lubrication

sop_examples.title: Pre-Stretch Roller Film Buildup Cleaning
sop_examples.condition: A sustained drop in pre_stretch_ratio_sensor readings or visible film residue buildup on the pre-stretch rollers indicates reduced effective stretch ratio requiring roller cleaning.
steps: Press red_estop_button to stop the machine before roller access
Read pre_stretch_ratio_sensor to record the baseline ratio before cleaning
Place cleaning_cloth against the upper pre-stretch roller surface and scrub to remove film residue, then repeat for the lower pre-stretch roller
Read pre_stretch_ratio_sensor after cleaning to confirm the ratio has returned to the 250 percent setpoint
Notify maintenance_tech if the ratio remains low after cleaning, indicating roller surface wear

sop_examples.title: Cutter Blade Scheduled Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The cutter blade replacement interval of 10,000 cut cycles has been reached, or the cutter_position_sensor shows extended actuation time per cycle indicating blade dullness.
steps: Press red_estop_button and confirm lockout per loto_procedure before touching the cutter
Pick cutter_blade_assembly from the cutter housing using the blade removal handle
Place cutter_blade_new into the cutter housing and secure the retaining clip
Notify maintenance_tech to verify blade seating and authorize lockout release

sop_examples.title: Turntable Drive Belt Inspection and Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The preventive maintenance schedule requires turntable drive belt inspection every 1,000 operating hours, or immediately when turntable_speed_sensor readings vary more than 0.5 RPM at constant load.
steps: Press red_estop_button and confirm lockout per loto_procedure before opening the drive housing
Read turntable_speed_sensor to log the current variance reading before belt access
Pick turntable_belt_worn from the drive belt housing after removing the access panel
Place turntable_belt_new onto the drive pulleys and verify tension with belt_tension_gauge

sop_examples.title: Emergency Stop Activation During Operation
sop_examples.condition: An operator observes any unsafe condition during wrapping including a person entering the safety zone, film wrapping around a non-load object, or any uncontrolled machine motion.
steps: Press red_estop_button at the nearest panel without delay
Walk to stretch_wrapper_station to visually confirm all machine motion has ceased
Read turntable_speed_sensor to verify zero-speed state
Read film_carriage_position_sensor to verify the carriage has stopped moving
Notify shift_supervisor immediately with the reason for e-stop activation and the approximate time
Wait 60 seconds for shift_supervisor to inspect the safety zone and authorize restart

sop_examples.title: Stretch Film Debris Accumulation Cleanup
sop_examples.condition: Stretch film scraps, cut tails, or loose wrap fragments have accumulated on the floor within 1 meter of the wrapper base, creating a slip and entanglement hazard for personnel and equipment.
steps: Press cycle_stop_button to halt any active or pending wrap cycle before entering the floor zone
Pick film_debris from the floor around the wrapper base
Read photoeye_sensor_A to confirm no debris remains in the safety beam path
Notify shift_supervisor that the cleanup is complete and the area is safe to resume operations

sop_examples.title: Daily Startup Sequence Before First Production Run
sop_examples.condition: The stretch wrapper is cold-started at the beginning of each production shift and requires a systematic readiness check before the first pallet is placed on the turntable.
steps: Press green_start_button to power up the control panel and initialize the PLC
Read film_tension_sensor to confirm tension reads within the 120 to 280 N window
Read turntable_speed_sensor during the jog test to verify the turntable reaches 6 RPM within 5 seconds
Read load_height_sensor to confirm the height sensor self-test returns a valid non-fault reading
Read photoeye_sensor_A and photoeye_sensor_B to confirm both safety beams are unobstructed
Notify shift_supervisor that the wrapper has passed the startup checklist and is cleared for production

sop_examples.title: End-of-Shift Shutdown Sequence
sop_examples.condition: Production has concluded for the current shift and the stretch wrapper must be safely shut down with film secured and the area cleared before handoff or overnight.
steps: Press cycle_stop_button to ensure no wrap cycle is pending or mid-queue
Pick film_tail_end from the film carriage to prevent unraveling
Place film_tail_end onto the film roll surface and press to adhere with a tape tab
Press red_estop_button to cut control power for the duration of the shutdown period
Notify shift_supervisor that the wrapper is shut down and the area is clear for the next shift

sop_examples.title: Film Pre-Stretch Tension System Calibration
sop_examples.condition: Following any pre-stretch roller replacement, or when the pre_stretch_ratio_sensor drifts more than 5 percent from the 250 percent target stretch ratio, a full tension calibration procedure is required.
steps: Press red_estop_button to secure the machine before calibration setup
Place calibration_weight_set onto the film carriage load cell bracket
Read film_tension_sensor to record the measured tension against the known calibration weight value
Read pre_stretch_ratio_sensor to verify the displayed ratio matches the reference value within 2 percent
Notify maintenance_tech if deviation exceeds 2 percent so the sensor zero-point can be adjusted
Press yellow_reset_button to accept calibration and return the wrapper to run mode

sop_examples.title: Machine Startup Sequence
sop_examples.condition: Surface grinder is powered off at shift start or after a maintenance hold and must be brought to full operational readiness.

sop_examples.title: End-of-Shift Shutdown
sop_examples.condition: Production shift is ending and the surface grinder must be powered down in a controlled, orderly manner.

sop_examples.title: Emergency Stop Activation
sop_examples.condition: An immediate hazard is detected — such as an operator injury, uncontrolled workpiece ejection, or visible smoke — requiring instantaneous machine halt with no sequenced power-down.

sop_examples.title: Lockout Tagout Procedure
sop_examples.condition: Planned maintenance or tooling work is scheduled on the surface grinder, requiring all energy sources to be isolated and locked before any personnel entry into the work envelope.

sop_examples.title: Minor Coolant Spill Response
sop_examples.condition: A small coolant leak of less than one gallon is observed pooling within the drip pan or the immediate floor area around the machine base, with no spread into walkways.

sop_examples.title: Major Coolant Rupture Response
sop_examples.condition: A large-volume coolant rupture is occurring — reservoir or hose burst — with fluid spreading beyond the drip pan and into the aisle floor, creating a slip hazard across a wide area.

sop_examples.title: Low Coolant Pressure Alarm
sop_examples.condition: The coolant pressure sensor reads below the 25 PSI minimum setpoint for more than ten continuous seconds, triggering the amber low-pressure advisory; the decline is gradual, consistent with a depleted reservoir rather than a line failure.

sop_examples.title: Sudden Coolant Pressure Collapse
sop_examples.condition: Coolant pressure drops from normal operating range to near-zero within two seconds, indicating a burst hose or catastrophic pump failure rather than gradual reservoir depletion; the pump audibly strains and flow ceases immediately.

sop_examples.title: High Coolant Pressure Alarm
sop_examples.condition: The coolant pressure sensor reads above the 80 PSI maximum ceiling, indicating a downstream blockage or a stuck pressure-relief valve that is preventing the system from regulating pressure.

sop_examples.title: Hydraulic Pressure Warning Alarm
sop_examples.condition: The hydraulic pressure sensor triggers the yellow advisory at the 1200 PSI low threshold, indicating the hydraulic circuit is approaching the bottom of its acceptable operating range; the machine remains operational and no immediate safety risk exists.

sop_examples.title: Hydraulic Pressure Critical Fault
sop_examples.condition: The hydraulic pressure sensor activates the red critical alarm at or below 800 PSI, indicating imminent loss of table clamping force and a serious risk of workpiece release during grinding; the machine must be halted immediately.

sop_examples.title: Grinding Wheel Imbalance Alarm
sop_examples.condition: The wheel balance sensor detects vibration amplitude exceeding 0.5 mm/s RMS during spindle rotation, signaling that the abrasive wheel is running dynamically out of balance.

sop_examples.title: Magnetic Chuck Demagnetization Fault
sop_examples.condition: The magnetic chuck sensor reads holding force below 3 kg/cm², indicating that the electromagnet has lost sufficient clamping strength to safely retain the workpiece during grinding passes.

sop_examples.title: Coolant Flow Blockage
sop_examples.condition: The coolant flow sensor reads zero or near-zero delivery at the nozzle despite the pump running at normal operating pressure, indicating that a clogged nozzle or filter obstruction is preventing coolant from reaching the grinding zone.

sop_examples.title: Table Reciprocation Jam
sop_examples.condition: The table position sensor reports that the grinding table has stalled mid-stroke and is no longer reciprocating, indicating a mechanical obstruction or hydraulic drive fault has seized the traverse movement.

sop_examples.title: Spindle Overheat Fault
sop_examples.condition: The spindle temperature sensor reads above 85 degrees Celsius, triggering the thermal overload alarm and indicating inadequate spindle cooling or a failing bearing that requires the spindle to cool before further diagnosis.

sop_examples.title: Abrasive Wheel Dressing
sop_examples.condition: The grinding wheel surface shows glazing or loading artifacts and the process engineer has confirmed a surface finish deviation on recent parts, requiring wheel truing before production can resume.

sop_examples.title: Coolant Filter Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The coolant filter differential-pressure indicator has reached the red band or the scheduled 500-hour service interval has elapsed, requiring the filter element to be replaced to restore full flow capacity.

sop_examples.title: Grinding Wheel Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The abrasive wheel has worn to minimum safe diameter or has sustained visible structural damage such as chipping or cracking, requiring full wheel removal and installation of a new wheel before grinding can resume.

sop_examples.title: Magnetic Chuck Surface Cleaning
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled weekly cleaning interval is due or metallic swarf buildup on the chuck face is visibly causing workpiece seating errors, and the chuck itself is holding force within normal range.

sop_examples.title: Way Lubrication System Inspection and Refill
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled 8-hour lubrication interval has elapsed or the lube level indicator at the lubrication panel is in the yellow zone, requiring way oil inspection and replenishment to prevent slideways from running dry.

sop_examples.title: Grinding Wheel Underspeed Fault
sop_examples.condition: The wheel speed sensor reads below the 1450 RPM minimum operating threshold during a run, indicating the spindle drive is failing to maintain target speed rather than exhibiting vibration from imbalance.

sop_examples.title: Torque Reading Below Minimum Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: The torque transducer reports a fastener tightening value that is consistently below the minimum specified torque setpoint for the current job program.

sop_examples.title: Mid-Cycle Torque Sudden Collapse
sop_examples.condition: Torque value abruptly drops to near-zero during an active fastening cycle after initially building normally, indicating spindle disengagement or a stripped fastener thread.

sop_examples.title: Torque Exceeds Maximum Ceiling
sop_examples.condition: The torque transducer detects a peak fastening value that exceeds the maximum allowable torque limit for the current joint specification, indicating over-tightening or joint failure.

sop_examples.title: Torque Approaching Upper Warning Threshold
sop_examples.condition: The torque monitoring system issues a caution alert because fastener torque values are trending toward the upper warning threshold but have not yet exceeded the maximum ceiling limit.

sop_examples.title: Nutrunner Spindle Mechanical Jam
sop_examples.condition: The nutrunner spindle is physically obstructed and will not rotate, with the drive motor reporting zero RPM despite receiving a valid run command and no overcurrent condition present.

sop_examples.title: Nutrunner Motor Stall Under Load
sop_examples.condition: The nutrunner drive motor stalls and draws excessive current when encountering fastener resistance during rundown, without any physical mechanical obstruction present in the spindle.

sop_examples.title: Torque Transducer Erratic Signal Fault
sop_examples.condition: The torque transducer outputs implausible, wildly fluctuating, or out-of-range readings that are not correlated with any active fastening operation, indicating sensor or signal cable failure.

sop_examples.title: Workpiece Fixture Clamp Failure
sop_examples.condition: The pneumatic workpiece fixture fails to reach confirmed clamp status before the fastening cycle begins, leaving the part unsecured in the nest and blocking cycle initiation.

sop_examples.title: Nutrunner Spindle Bearing Lubrication
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled spindle bearing lubrication interval has been reached per the preventive maintenance calendar or cumulative run-hours counter.

sop_examples.title: Drive Unit Gearbox Oil Change
sop_examples.condition: The periodic gearbox oil change interval has elapsed or oil analysis from a sample pull indicates degraded lubricant in the nutrunner drive unit gearbox.

sop_examples.title: Torque Transducer Calibration
sop_examples.condition: The annual calibration interval for the torque transducer has been reached, or a calibration drift has been identified during a quality audit of fastener output values.

sop_examples.title: Drive Socket and Bit Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The nutrunner drive socket or bit is worn beyond acceptable dimensional limits as identified during routine inspection or following a torque fault or cross-threading event.

sop_examples.title: Pneumatic Fixture Air Filter Service
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled service interval for the pneumatic fixture clamp system air filter has been reached, or measured filter differential pressure exceeds the maximum allowable threshold.

sop_examples.title: Torque Reaction Bar Wear Inspection
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled inspection interval for the torque reaction bar has been reached to verify freedom from cracks, deformation, or wear that could compromise torque measurement accuracy or structural integrity.

sop_examples.title: Signal and Power Cable Connector Inspection
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled inspection interval for torque station signal and power cable connectors has been reached to check for corrosion, physical damage, or loose connections that could cause measurement errors.

sop_examples.title: Torque Station Lockout Tagout Procedure
sop_examples.condition: Planned maintenance or repair work on the torque station requires full energy isolation of all electrical, pneumatic, and mechanical energy sources before personnel access internal components.

sop_examples.title: Emergency Stop Activation and Reset
sop_examples.condition: An emergency stop has been triggered at the torque station due to an unexpected safety hazard, uncontrolled equipment event, or automatic protective device activation requiring an immediate and complete halt of all motion.

sop_examples.title: Personnel Work Envelope Incursion Response
sop_examples.condition: A person or unauthorized object has entered the robot and nutrunner work envelope at the torque station while the system is in automatic operation mode, triggering the area safety scanner.

sop_examples.title: Daily Startup and Verification Sequence
sop_examples.condition: Beginning of a production shift requires controlled startup and system verification of the torque station before any production parts are run through the fastening cycle.

sop_examples.title: End-of-Shift Controlled Shutdown
sop_examples.condition: Production shift has ended and the torque station must be de-energized in a controlled sequence to preserve equipment condition and ensure the work cell is in a safe state for the next shift.

sop_examples.title: Fastener Torque Quality Audit
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled quality audit requires verification that completed assemblies leaving the torque station meet fastener torque specifications by sampling and bench-checking production output.

sop_examples.title: Fastener Rundown Angle Inspection
sop_examples.condition: Fastener rundown angle data logged by the nutrunner controller falls outside acceptable limits for the current joint program, suggesting cross-threading, wrong fastener, or a poor joint condition.

sop_examples.title: Tank Temperature Below Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: The temperature sensor on the ultrasonic cleaning tank reads more than 5°C below the programmed setpoint (typically 55°C) during a sustained normal-operation window.
steps: notify maintenance_tech if temperature has not recovered to within 3°C of setpoint

sop_examples.title: Sudden Tank Temperature Collapse
sop_examples.condition: The tank temperature sensor shows a drop of 10°C or more within a 2-minute window, indicating possible heater element failure or catastrophic cold-load ingestion rather than gradual drift.
steps: press_button estop_button if heater_status_indicator reads FAULT

sop_examples.title: Tank Temperature Overheat Alarm
sop_examples.condition: The tank temperature sensor reads above the maximum safe operating ceiling (65°C), triggering the overheat alarm on the control panel during active operation.
steps: notify supervisor if temperature remains above 60°C after the cool-down wait

sop_examples.title: Tank Solution Level Low Warning
sop_examples.condition: The solution level sensor triggers the amber low-level warning when the fluid drops below the 75% mark on the tank sight glass, while transducers remain fully submerged.

sop_examples.title: Tank Solution Level Critical Immediate Shutdown
sop_examples.condition: The solution level sensor registers below the transducer-exposure threshold (50% of tank capacity), risking cavitation damage to transducer faces and incomplete part submersion.

sop_examples.title: Minor Tank Fitting Leak Response
sop_examples.condition: A small drip or seep is observed at a tank fitting, drain valve, or pipe joint with a fluid loss rate under 0.5 L/min and no continuous floor pooling outside the containment berm.

sop_examples.title: Major Tank Rupture Emergency Response
sop_examples.condition: A catastrophic breach of the tank wall, weld seam, or drain line produces significant fluid pooling on the floor outside the containment berm and activates the floor leak detector alarm.

sop_examples.title: Transducer Electrical Fault Alarm
sop_examples.condition: The transducer fault indicator illuminates on the control panel, signaling an electrical open-circuit, short-circuit, or overcurrent condition in one or more transducer elements.

sop_examples.title: Ultrasonic Frequency Out of Specification
sop_examples.condition: The frequency monitor reads outside the ±2 kHz tolerance band around the 40 kHz nominal, indicating resonance drift without any transducer electrical fault code present on the panel.
steps: notify maintenance_tech if frequency remains outside 38-42 kHz band

sop_examples.title: Ultrasonic Power Unit Overload Alarm
sop_examples.condition: The power unit overload alarm activates, indicating the generator is drawing above rated current, without a concurrent transducer electrical fault code appearing on the panel.
steps: notify maintenance_tech if overload indicator re-trips after reset

sop_examples.title: Full Solution Drain and Refill
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled solution replacement is due per the weekly maintenance calendar, or solution contamination or discoloration has been confirmed by quality inspection.

sop_examples.title: Periodic Transducer Surface Inspection and Cleaning
sop_examples.condition: Monthly transducer inspection interval is due, or visual scale buildup or erosion is observed on transducer faces during a routine visual check with the tank drained.
steps: notify maintenance_tech if erosion depth exceeds 2 mm on any face

sop_examples.title: Immersion Heater Element Inspection
sop_examples.condition: The quarterly heater inspection interval is reached, or the heater fails to bring the bath to setpoint within the standard 15-minute warm-up window.
steps: notify maintenance_tech if resistance reading falls outside the 18-22 ohm acceptable range

sop_examples.title: Filtration System Filter Cartridge Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The filter differential-pressure indicator reads above 15 psi, indicating a loaded cartridge, or the bi-weekly scheduled replacement interval is reached.

sop_examples.title: Ultrasonic Power and Frequency Calibration
sop_examples.condition: The quarterly calibration interval is reached, or post-maintenance re-verification is required after transducer array replacement or generator service.
steps: notify maintenance_tech if any acoustic power or frequency reading deviates more than 5% from the reference standard

sop_examples.title: Lockout Tagout Procedure for Maintenance Isolation
sop_examples.condition: Any scheduled or corrective maintenance requiring physical access to the tank interior, immersion heater, transducer array, or drive electronics cabinet is about to begin.
steps: notify maintenance_tech that machine isolation is confirmed

sop_examples.title: Cleaning Solution Spill Response
sop_examples.condition: Cleaning solution has escaped the tank containment berm and is present on the plant floor, detected visually by the operator or triggered by the floor leak sensor alarm.

sop_examples.title: Emergency Stop Activation and Verification
sop_examples.condition: An imminent safety hazard is observed at or near the ultrasonic cleaner — such as personnel contact risk, fire, or unknown loud event — requiring immediate cessation of all machine motion and energy output.

sop_examples.title: Normal Ultrasonic Cleaner Startup Sequence
sop_examples.condition: The cleaning system is in a fully de-energized state and must be brought to operational readiness at the start of a production shift or after a planned shutdown.

sop_examples.title: Normal Ultrasonic Cleaner Shutdown Sequence
sop_examples.condition: Production shift is ending or a planned shutdown is required, with the cleaning cycle complete and no parts remaining in the tank.

sop_examples.title: Post Clean Part Cleanliness Inspection
sop_examples.condition: A batch of parts has completed the ultrasonic cleaning cycle and must be verified for surface cleanliness before transfer to the next production stage.
steps: notify quality_inspector if any part fails the cleanliness threshold

sop_examples.title: Cleaning Solution Concentration Verification
sop_examples.condition: The start-of-shift solution check interval is reached, or a process quality alert has flagged potential solution degradation or over-dilution.
steps: notify maintenance_tech if reading is outside the 5 to 8 percent concentration range

sop_examples.title: VFD Overcurrent Fault Response
sop_examples.condition: The drive display shows an overcurrent fault code and the motor circuit has tripped offline due to measured phase current exceeding the drive's protection threshold.

sop_examples.title: DC Bus Overvoltage Fault Response
sop_examples.condition: The DC bus voltage sensor reading has risen above the drive's upper fault threshold, causing the drive to trip on an overvoltage condition.

sop_examples.title: DC Bus Undervoltage Alarm Response
sop_examples.condition: The DC bus voltage sensor reading has drifted gradually below the minimum operating setpoint during normal running conditions while the drive remains online.

sop_examples.title: DC Bus Sudden Voltage Collapse Response
sop_examples.condition: The DC bus voltage drops instantaneously to near-zero within a single control scan cycle, indicating catastrophic input power loss or an internal hard fault rather than a gradual undervoltage drift.

sop_examples.title: Drive Heatsink Overtemperature Warning
sop_examples.condition: The heatsink temperature sensor has triggered a warning-level alarm but the drive remains running and has not yet reached the automatic shutdown threshold.

sop_examples.title: Drive Overtemperature Emergency Shutdown
sop_examples.condition: The heatsink temperature has exceeded the drive's emergency shutdown threshold and the drive has already tripped itself offline to prevent thermal damage.

sop_examples.title: Ground Fault Detection Response
sop_examples.condition: The ground fault relay has activated, indicating an insulation breakdown between a phase conductor and the cabinet ground path that requires immediate isolation.

sop_examples.title: Cooling Fan Degraded Speed Warning
sop_examples.condition: The cooling fan RPM sensor reads below rated speed but the fan is still rotating, triggering a warning-level alarm while the drive continues to run.

sop_examples.title: Cooling Fan Complete Failure Emergency
sop_examples.condition: The cooling fan RPM sensor reads zero, confirming the fan has fully stopped with no rotation, and immediate drive shutdown is required to prevent thermal runaway.

sop_examples.title: Scheduled Inlet Air Filter Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The preventive maintenance calendar interval for the cabinet inlet air filter has elapsed and replacement is due regardless of differential pressure reading.

sop_examples.title: Clogged Inlet Air Filter Unscheduled Replacement
sop_examples.condition: The differential pressure sensor across the inlet air filter reads above the high-limit setpoint, indicating a blockage that is restricting airflow and causing elevated cabinet temperatures ahead of schedule.

sop_examples.title: DC Bus Capacitor Scheduled Inspection
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled inspection interval for DC bus electrolytic capacitors has elapsed and a visual and measurement check is required per the preventive maintenance calendar.

sop_examples.title: Power and Control Terminal Re-Torque
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled re-torque interval for all power and control terminal connections inside the cabinet has elapsed per the preventive maintenance plan.

sop_examples.title: Cabinet Interior Dust and Debris Cleaning
sop_examples.condition: Accumulated dust and debris on internal components has reached the cleaning threshold per the maintenance schedule.

sop_examples.title: Drive Heat Sink Fin Cleaning
sop_examples.condition: Heat sink fins have been found to have debris deposits identified during a thermal inspection, requiring compressed-air cleaning to restore thermal performance.

sop_examples.title: VFD Output Frequency Calibration Verification
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled calibration check interval requires verifying that the VFD output frequency matches the commanded speed setpoint within the specified tolerance.

sop_examples.title: VFD Cabinet Lockout Tagout Procedure
sop_examples.condition: A maintenance task requires opening the VFD cabinet door with personnel exposure to internal components, necessitating full energy isolation before any work begins.

sop_examples.title: Fire or Emergency Stop Response
sop_examples.condition: A fire alarm has activated or visible smoke or flame is detected in or near the VFD cabinet, requiring immediate machine de-energization and evacuation.

sop_examples.title: DC Bus Capacitor Discharge Verification
sop_examples.condition: After cabinet de-energization and lockout, the DC bus must be confirmed fully discharged before any personnel make physical contact with internal components.

sop_examples.title: VFD Cabinet Normal Startup Sequence
sop_examples.condition: The VFD cabinet is to be energized and brought online following a planned outage or at the start of a production shift with no active faults present.

sop_examples.title: VFD Cabinet Normal Shutdown Sequence
sop_examples.condition: A planned shutdown of the VFD cabinet is required at the end of a production shift or prior to a scheduled maintenance window.

sop_examples.title: Post-Fault Restart After Cleared Fault
sop_examples.condition: A non-emergency VFD fault has been investigated and root cause resolved, and the drive is ready to be restarted following confirmed fault clearance and technician sign-off.

sop_examples.title: Bowl Track Jam Clearance
sop_examples.condition: A part has become wedged crosswise or stacked in the bowl track, causing the feeder to stop delivering parts to the output chute.

sop_examples.title: Intermittent Parts Bridging At Hopper Entry
sop_examples.condition: Parts are bridging across the hopper entry funnel causing erratic, on-and-off feed while the feeder continues to run and the hopper is not empty.

sop_examples.title: Feed Rate Below Minimum Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: The feed rate sensor reads below the minimum parts-per-minute setpoint for more than 30 consecutive seconds while the feeder drive coil remains energized and the bowl is not empty.

sop_examples.title: Sudden Feed Rate Collapse To Zero
sop_examples.condition: The feed rate sensor drops abruptly to zero output in a single scan cycle while the drive coil remains energized and no jam alarm is active.

sop_examples.title: Feed Rate Exceeds Maximum Ceiling
sop_examples.condition: The feed rate sensor reads above the upper control limit, risking overflow of the downstream assembly accumulator.

sop_examples.title: Drive Coil Overcurrent Fault
sop_examples.condition: The drive coil current sensor exceeds maximum rated amperage, tripping overcurrent protection and cutting power to the feeder.

sop_examples.title: Drive Coil Voltage Below Operating Minimum
sop_examples.condition: Supply voltage to the drive coil drops below the minimum operating threshold, causing weak or sluggish bowl vibration without tripping any overcurrent protection.

sop_examples.title: Parts Level Low Warning
sop_examples.condition: The bowl parts level sensor crosses the low-level warning threshold, indicating supply is running down but the feeder is still running and output has not yet stopped.

sop_examples.title: Parts Hopper Completely Empty Emergency
sop_examples.condition: The parts level sensor reads zero and feeder output has stopped entirely because the hopper and bowl are fully depleted of parts.

sop_examples.title: Excessive Parts Orientation Reject Rate
sop_examples.condition: The orientation sensor is rejecting and recirculating more than 15 percent of parts per cycle, indicating a bowl track tooling defect or an incorrect part loaded in the feeder.

sop_examples.title: Abnormal Vibration Warning
sop_examples.condition: The vibration monitor reads above the normal operating band continuously for more than 60 seconds, indicating a developing mechanical issue while the feeder remains within safe operating limits.

sop_examples.title: Severe Vibration Emergency Stop
sop_examples.condition: The vibration monitor spikes to the emergency shutdown threshold or a loud metallic impact is detected, posing immediate structural risk to the feeder mounting and surrounding equipment.

sop_examples.title: Scheduled Bowl Track Cleaning
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled cleaning interval has been reached or contamination, oil film, or debris is observed on the bowl track surface.

sop_examples.title: Drive Coil Spring Assembly Lubrication
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled lubrication interval has been reached for the drive coil leaf spring mounting points and contact surfaces.

sop_examples.title: Leaf Spring Inspection And Replacement
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled leaf spring inspection interval is due or an abnormal vibration pattern suggests spring fatigue or physical damage to one or more leaf springs.

sop_examples.title: Bowl Liner Replacement
sop_examples.condition: Bowl liner inspection reveals wear, cracking, or delamination beyond acceptable tolerance limits, or liner material fragments are found in the output stream.

sop_examples.title: Parts Level Sensor Calibration
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled calibration interval is due for the bowl level sensor or an operator has reported that the displayed level reading does not match the observed fill state.

sop_examples.title: Lockout Tagout For Feeder Maintenance
sop_examples.condition: Maintenance work requiring hands-on physical access to feeder internals, drive components, or the bowl itself, necessitating complete electrical energy isolation before work begins.

sop_examples.title: Small Parts Floor Spill Response
sop_examples.condition: Small parts have spilled onto the floor in the feeder work area, creating a slip and trip hazard for personnel.

sop_examples.title: Emergency Stop Activation And Reset
sop_examples.condition: The feeder emergency stop has been activated either automatically by the control system or manually by an operator, halting all feeder motion.

sop_examples.title: Feeder Normal Startup Sequence
sop_examples.condition: Beginning-of-shift or post-maintenance startup with the feeder in a full shutdown state and all safety checks signed off.

sop_examples.title: Feeder Normal End-Of-Shift Shutdown
sop_examples.condition: End-of-shift or planned shutdown with the feeder operating normally and production for the period complete.

sop_examples.title: Camera Signal Loss Recovery
sop_examples.condition: One or more inspection cameras shows no video feed on the vision controller display.

sop_examples.title: Lighting Intensity Gradual Drift Below Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: The ambient light sensor records a slow, continuous decline to below the 350-lux minimum threshold over the course of a shift, triggering a low-light advisory alarm.

sop_examples.title: Instantaneous Lighting Failure Response
sop_examples.condition: The ambient light sensor drops to zero or near-zero instantaneously within a single scan cycle, indicating a bulb burnout or LED driver failure rather than a gradual drift.

sop_examples.title: Reject Gate Physical Jam Clearance
sop_examples.condition: The reject gate actuator is energized and commanded to the reject position but the gate does not move and the gate position sensor reads zero displacement after 3 seconds.

sop_examples.title: Reject Gate Delayed Actuation Response
sop_examples.condition: The reject gate moves to the reject position but consistently takes more than 1.5 seconds after the trigger signal, causing parts to occasionally clear the gate before it closes fully.

sop_examples.title: Excessive False Reject Rate Response
sop_examples.condition: The vision system is flagging and diverting more than 5% of parts to the reject bin that quality sampling confirms are conforming to dimensional and surface specifications.

sop_examples.title: High Defect Miss Rate Response
sop_examples.condition: Post-process audit or customer feedback confirms that defective parts are passing through the vision station and receiving a PASS disposition, indicating the system is under-detecting flaws.

sop_examples.title: Camera Thermal Warning Response
sop_examples.condition: A camera body temperature sensor triggers a WARNING-level amber alarm indicating temperature above 55 degrees C but below the 70 degree C emergency shutdown threshold, with the system still running.

sop_examples.title: Scheduled Camera Lens Cleaning
sop_examples.condition: The vision controller triggers an 8-hour interval lens contamination flag, or an operator observes smearing or hazing on live camera images consistent with oil mist or coolant overspray on the lens.

sop_examples.title: Lighting Diffusion Filter Replacement
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled 500-hour PM interval is reached or the lighting uniformity sensor triggers a diffusion degradation alarm indicating non-uniform illumination across the inspection zone.

sop_examples.title: Reject Gate Actuator Lubrication
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled weekly PM task for lubricating the reject gate pneumatic actuator rod and pivot bearings is due, or an operator reports audible squealing or grinding from the gate mechanism.

sop_examples.title: Vision System Full Calibration
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled 30-day calibration PM interval is reached or a calibration-due alarm is displayed on the vision controller, requiring the full calibration sequence with the reference target board.

sop_examples.title: Camera Field-of-View Alignment Verification
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled bi-weekly alignment verification is due or the vision controller reports an alignment drift alarm indicating the active field of view has shifted from the nominal center position.

sop_examples.title: Vision Enclosure Air Filter Replacement
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled monthly PM is due or the enclosure HVAC pressure differential sensor triggers a clog alarm indicating restricted airflow through the inlet filter.

sop_examples.title: Reject Gate Actuator Pneumatic Seal Replacement
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled annual PM is due or a slow pneumatic leakdown is audible at the reject gate actuator body, indicating worn or failed internal seals.

sop_examples.title: Vision Station Lockout-Tagout Procedure
sop_examples.condition: Any task requiring physical entry into the inspection enclosure or hands-on work involving electrical, pneumatic, or mechanical components of the vision station.

sop_examples.title: Lens Cleaner Solvent Spill Response
sop_examples.condition: Lens cleaning solvent or isopropyl alcohol is spilled within or immediately adjacent to the vision station enclosure, creating a slip hazard or chemical exposure risk.

sop_examples.title: Vision Station Emergency Stop Activation
sop_examples.condition: Any unsafe condition, uncontrolled mechanical motion, personnel hazard, smoke, or imminent equipment damage is observed at the vision station requiring immediate cessation of all motion.

sop_examples.title: Vision Station Startup Sequence
sop_examples.condition: Beginning of production shift or return from any planned downtime requiring the vision station to be brought from a fully de-energized state to production-ready operation.

sop_examples.title: Vision Station End-of-Shift Shutdown
sop_examples.condition: End of the production shift or start of planned downtime requiring orderly shutdown of the vision station from production-running state to fully de-energized.

sop_examples.title: First Article Inspection Program Setup
sop_examples.condition: A new part number or tooling changeover requires selection of the correct vision inspection program and a golden-part verification pass before production is released to run.

sop_examples.title: Golden Part Start-of-Shift Verification Run
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled start-of-shift or post-maintenance check requiring the certified golden-part sample set to be run through the active inspection program to confirm current detection accuracy before production begins.

sop_examples.title: Low Discharge Pressure Alarm Response
sop_examples.condition: Pump discharge pressure sensor reads below the 45 PSI minimum setpoint for more than 30 seconds during normal operation, with a gradual or steady drift.

sop_examples.title: Sudden Pressure Collapse Emergency Response
sop_examples.condition: Pump discharge pressure drops from normal operating range to below 20 PSI within 5 seconds, indicating a catastrophic line break or valve failure rather than a gradual drift.

sop_examples.title: High Discharge Pressure Alarm Response
sop_examples.condition: Pump discharge pressure sensor reads above the 85 PSI maximum ceiling during normal operation.

sop_examples.title: Low Process Water Flow Rate Alarm Response
sop_examples.condition: Process water flow rate sensor reads below the 12 GPM minimum threshold while pump motor status confirms the motor is running.

sop_examples.title: Complete Loss of Process Water Flow Response
sop_examples.condition: Process water flow rate sensor reads zero while pump motor status confirms the motor is energized and running, indicating total blockage or impeller failure.

sop_examples.title: Pressure Tank Pre-Charge Below Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: Pressure tank pre-charge gauge reads below the 30 PSI nitrogen pre-charge setpoint during a scheduled or walk-around inspection.

sop_examples.title: Pump Motor Over-Temperature Alarm Response
sop_examples.condition: Pump motor winding temperature sensor exceeds the 155 degree Celsius alarm threshold.

sop_examples.title: Pump Motor Electrical Fault Response
sop_examples.condition: Motor control center indicates an overcurrent trip or phase loss fault on the pump motor circuit, preventing normal pump operation.

sop_examples.title: Minor Pump Mechanical Seal Drip Response
sop_examples.condition: Pump mechanical seal area shows a slow drip leak at a rate below one drop per second, identified during visual inspection or by leak detector.

sop_examples.title: Major Pipe Rupture Emergency Isolation
sop_examples.condition: Process water is actively spraying or gushing from a pipe, fitting, or joint at high velocity, creating an uncontrolled water release.

sop_examples.title: Routine Pump Mechanical Seal Inspection
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled 500-hour inspection interval for the pump mechanical seal assembly has elapsed.

sop_examples.title: Pump Inlet Filter Element Replacement
sop_examples.condition: Pump inlet strainer differential pressure sensor reads above 5 PSI, indicating the filter element is loaded and requires replacement.

sop_examples.title: Pump Bearing Lubrication Service
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled 250-hour lubrication interval for pump bearing assemblies on both pump units has elapsed.

sop_examples.title: Pressure Relief Valve Functional Test
sop_examples.condition: The quarterly functional test interval is due for the pump station pressure relief valve.

sop_examples.title: Pressure Tank Bladder Nitrogen Recharge
sop_examples.condition: Pressure tank nitrogen pre-charge has been confirmed below setpoint and the tank bladder requires nitrogen recharge to restore the 30 PSI pre-charge.

sop_examples.title: Routine Pump Bearing Vibration Measurement
sop_examples.condition: The scheduled weekly vibration measurement is due on all bearing measurement points on pump units 1 and 2.

sop_examples.title: Pump Station Lockout Tagout Procedure
sop_examples.condition: Pump station requires full isolation of electrical and hydraulic energy sources prior to maintenance or repair work on pump internals or connected piping.

sop_examples.title: Process Water Floor Spill Response
sop_examples.condition: Standing water or pooling is observed on the pump station floor and is not associated with an active spray, pipe rupture, or seal failure.

sop_examples.title: Pump Station Emergency Stop Activation
sop_examples.condition: An imminent safety hazard at the pump station requires immediate halt of all pump station equipment with no time for normal shutdown sequencing.

sop_examples.title: Pump Station Normal Startup
sop_examples.condition: Pump station is in a safe de-energized state and is ready to be brought online for production at the start of a shift or after a maintenance window.

sop_examples.title: Pump Station Normal Shutdown
sop_examples.condition: Production has ended and the pump station requires a planned, controlled shutdown at end of shift or prior to a scheduled maintenance window.

sop_examples.title: Process Water Quality and Turbidity Inspection
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled daily quality inspection of process water turbidity and contamination level is due at the process water sample port.

sop_examples.title: Solder Pot Temperature Below Minimum Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: Solder pot temperature sensor reads below 245 degrees C, the minimum operating threshold, while the machine is in normal production mode with no rate-of-change alarm active.

sop_examples.title: Solder Pot Temperature Rapid Drop
sop_examples.condition: Solder pot temperature drops more than 15 degrees C within two minutes while the machine is running, indicating a heater element failure or thermal runaway condition requiring immediate intervention.

sop_examples.title: Solder Pot Temperature Above Maximum Ceiling
sop_examples.condition: Solder pot temperature sensor reads above 280 degrees C, triggering the overtemperature alarm and risking accelerated solder oxidation, dross formation, and alloy composition drift.

sop_examples.title: Flux Reservoir Level Low Warning
sop_examples.condition: Flux reservoir level sensor falls below the 20 percent threshold, triggering the low-level warning indicator on the flux control panel while the pump remains operational.

sop_examples.title: Flux System Pressure Exceeds Rated Limit
sop_examples.condition: Flux pump pressure sensor reads above 4.5 bar, exceeding the system rated maximum and posing risk of line rupture, spray nozzle damage, or uncontrolled flux discharge.

sop_examples.title: Conveyor Speed Below Setpoint
sop_examples.condition: Conveyor tachometer reads more than 15 percent below the programmed speed setpoint while boards are present and the drive motor remains energized without a fault code.

sop_examples.title: Conveyor Fully Stopped Mid-Cycle Hard Jam
sop_examples.condition: Conveyor motion sensor reads zero velocity while the drive motor is energized and boards are loaded in the machine, indicating a hard mechanical jam rather than a programmed stop.

sop_examples.title: Solder Wave Height Below Specification
sop_examples.condition: Wave height sensor reads below the 8 mm minimum specification, indicating insufficient pump speed or nozzle restriction causing incomplete solder contact with PCB pads.

sop_examples.title: Solder Wave Height Above Specification
sop_examples.condition: Wave height sensor reads above the 12 mm maximum specification, causing solder flooding, bridging across adjacent pads, or solder splashing onto component bodies.

sop_examples.title: Preheat Zone Temperature Below Lower Process Limit
sop_examples.condition: Preheat zone thermocouple reads below 90 degrees C, the lower process limit, causing insufficient flux carrier evaporation and potential cold solder joint formation with no active alarm horn.

sop_examples.title: Preheat Zone Critical Overtemperature Alarm
sop_examples.condition: Preheat zone thermocouple exceeds 160 degrees C, triggering the critical overtemperature alarm horn and red indicator, posing immediate risk of board delamination, component damage, or flux ignition.

sop_examples.title: Conveyor Drive Motor Overcurrent Fault
sop_examples.condition: Conveyor drive motor current sensor exceeds the 12-amp overcurrent trip threshold and the VFD displays a fault code, indicating mechanical overload or motor winding degradation rather than a chain jam.

sop_examples.title: Minor Solder Seepage from Pot Joint or Nozzle Fitting
sop_examples.condition: A small drip or seepage of molten solder is observed at a pot gasket joint or nozzle fitting with no floor pooling, machine remaining in controlled operation and solder contained to the machine base area.

sop_examples.title: Major Solder Spill or Pot Rupture
sop_examples.condition: A large volume of molten solder is pooling on the floor or machine base, or the solder pot has ruptured, creating an immediate burn and fire hazard requiring full machine shutdown and area evacuation.

sop_examples.title: Solder Pot Dross Removal and Skimming
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled dross removal interval is reached, or dross accumulation on the solder pot surface visually exceeds 30 percent coverage and risks being drawn into the wave pump.

sop_examples.title: Flux System Filter Replacement
sop_examples.condition: Flux filter service interval has elapsed, or pressure drop across the flux filter housing exceeds 0.8 bar indicating a clogged element that restricts pump flow.

sop_examples.title: Conveyor Finger and Chain Cleaning
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled conveyor cleaning interval is reached, or flux residue and solder buildup on conveyor fingers is observed during inspection and poses risk of board slippage or contamination transfer.

sop_examples.title: Wave Nozzle Cleaning and Wave Height Calibration
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled nozzle maintenance interval is reached, or wave profile irregularities such as asymmetric cresting or partial restriction are observed during inspection window checks.

sop_examples.title: Flux Spray Nozzle Flow Rate Calibration
sop_examples.condition: Scheduled flux nozzle calibration interval is reached, or flux coverage uniformity fails visual inspection with dry patches observed on boards exiting the flux station.

sop_examples.title: Solder Level Low Ingot Addition to Pot
sop_examples.condition: Solder level sensor trips the low-level indicator while wave pump remains operational, requiring addition of solder ingots before the level drops further and wave formation degrades.

sop_examples.title: Lockout-Tagout for Scheduled Maintenance
sop_examples.condition: A maintenance work order is issued requiring physical isolation of all energy sources on the wave soldering machine before personnel enter the machine guarded zone.

sop_examples.title: Fire Detection or Emergency Stop Activation
sop_examples.condition: Smoke detector or flame sensor activates above the machine, or an operator manually triggers the emergency stop due to visible fire, severe flux ignition, or imminent injury hazard.

sop_examples.title: Press Jam Part Retrieval and Machine Isolation
sop_examples.condition: A part has jammed inside the assembly press feed area and halted the cycle. The jammed part must be retrieved and moved to the staging area, the press reset via the yellow reset button, and the machine isolated by pulling the main isolation lever down before any manual intervention near the press.
